descriptionByLocale.de:
IM Das Intelligent Maintenance and Operations Systems (IMOS) Lab bei der EPFL sucht einen motivierten und fachübergreifenden Forschungsprofessor (100%, in Lausanne, befristet) ab September oder nach Vereinbarung. Projektbeschreibung Ziel dieses Projekts ist es, neue Methoden auf Basis von physikinformierten Graphen-Neuralnetzwerken (PI-GNs) zu entwickeln, um die Auswirkungen von Betriebsbelastungen auf den Systemabbau auf der lückenlosen Ebene in komplexen Engineering-Systemen zu verstehen und zu modellieren, wobei insbesondere Windenergieanlagen im Fokus stehen. Die Forschung konzentriert sich auf die explizite Integration von physikalischen Gesetzen, Lastdynamik und Abbaumechanismen in graphische Modelle und ermöglicht ein prinzipielles Verständnis, wie Betriebsbedingungen die Entwicklung der Systemgesundheit im Laufe der Zeit vorantreiben. Besonderes Augenmerk wird auf die spatiotemporale Modellierung interagierender Subsysteme gelegt, bei denen der Abbau aus gekoppelten physikalischen Prozessen über Komponenten entsteht. Das Projekt wird untersuchen, wie graphische Darstellungen erfasst werden können:
• die Ausbreitung von Lasten und Spannungen über miteinander verbundene Bauteile,
• die Anhäufung von Müdigkeit und Beschädigung unter variablen Belastungsbedingungen und
• die Wechselwirkung zwischen struktureller Dynamik und Abbauprozessen. Ein zentraler Aspekt der Forschung ist die Einbeziehung von physikbasierten induktiven Bias in Lernarchitekturen. Dies ermöglicht die Entwicklung von Modellen, die unter unterschiedlichen Betriebsbedingungen physisch konsistent, interpretierbar und robust sind und über rein datengesteuerte Ansätze hinausgehen. Zu den Anwendungen gehören komplexe Industrie- und Energiesysteme, insbesondere Windenergieanlagen, wobei Lastbedingungen den Abbau kritischer Bauteile wie Schaufeln, Getriebe und Lager unmittelbar beeinflussen. Die entwickelten Methoden tragen zur Verbesserung der Lebensdauermodellierung, Zuverlässigkeitsbewertung und physikinformierter Vorhersagewartung bei. Diese PhD-Position ist Teil eines ERC Consolidator Grants, der innovative Forschung über physikinformierte KI, intelligente Wartung und die Modellierung von Abbauprozessen in komplexen Systemen unterstützt. Profil Wir suchen einen Doktoranden mit einem starken analytischen Hintergrund und einem hervorragenden MSc-Abschluss in Maschinenbau, Informatik, Ingenieurwissenschaften, Physik, Angewandte Mathematik oder einem eng verwandten Bereich. Sie sollten eine solide Grundlage für maschinelles Lernen (z.B. Deep Learning) und mathematische Modellierung haben, einschließlich Erfahrung mit dynamischen Systemen oder Differentialgleichungen. Es wird ein starkes Interesse an der Modellierung physikalischer Systeme und Abbauprozesse (z.B. Müdigkeit, Schadensersatz) erwartet. Die Erfahrung mit graphischen neuronalen Netzwerken oder spatiotemporalen Modellen ist sehr wünschenswert, sowie die Vertrautheit mit physikalisch-informierten Ansätzen, die physische induktive Vorspannung in Lernmodelle integrieren. Die Kenntnis eines oder mehrerer der folgenden Bereiche gilt als starker Vermögenswert:
• Physikalisch-informiertes maschinelles Lernen und hybride Modellierungsansätze
• Computational Mechanik, Strukturdynamik oder Ermüdungs- und Schadensmodellierung
• Signalverarbeitung und Analyse von Messdaten aus physikalischen Systemen
• Wissenschaftliches maschinelles Lernen oder numerische Methoden für physikalische Systeme Es werden starke Programmierkenntnisse und die Fähigkeit zur Arbeit an der Schnittstelle von maschinellem Lernen und physikalisch-basierter Modellierung von Engineering-Systemen erwartet. Wir erwarten, dass der Kandidat selbstfahrend ist, mit starken Problemlösungen Fähigkeiten und Out-of-the-box Denken. Der professionelle Befehl von Englisch (beide geschrieben und gesprochen) ist obligatorisch. IMOS Le laboratoire des systèmes intelligents de maintenance et d'exploitation (IMOS) de l'EPFL est à la recherche d'un doctorant motivé et à la mode (100 % à Lausanne, durée déterminée) à partir de septembre ou sur accord. Description du projet L'objectif de ce projet est de mettre au point de nouvelles méthodologies basées sur des réseaux neuraux de graphes (PI-GNN) éclairés par la physique pour comprendre et modéliser l'impact des charges opérationnelles sur la dégradation des systèmes au niveau de la compenence dans des systèmes d'ingénierie complexes, en mettant l'accent sur les éoliennes. La recherche sera axée sur l'intégration explicite des lois physiques, de la dynamique de charge et des mécanismes de dégradation dans des modèles basés sur des graphiques, permettant ainsi une compréhension de principe de la façon dont les conditions d'exploitation déterminent l'évolution de la santé du système au fil du temps. L'accent sera mis en particulier sur la modélisation spatiotemporelle des sous-systèmes en interaction, où la dégradation émerge de processus physiques couplés entre les composants. Le projet explorera comment les représentations basées sur des graphiques peuvent saisir:
• la propagation des charges et des contraintes entre les composants interconnectés,
• l'accumulation de fatigue et de dommages dans des conditions de chargement variables, et
• l'interaction entre la dynamique structurelle et les processus de dégradation. Un aspect central de la recherche est l'incorporation de biais inductifs fondés sur la physique dans les architectures d'apprentissage. Cela permettra l'élaboration de modèles qui sont physiquement cohérents, interprétables et robustes dans des conditions de fonctionnement variables, allant au-delà des approches purement fondées sur les données. Les applications comprendront des systèmes industriels et énergétiques complexes, l'accent étant mis en particulier sur les éoliennes, où les conditions de charge influencent directement la dégradation des composants essentiels tels que les lames, les boîtes de vitesses et les roulements. Les méthodes développées contribueront à améliorer la modélisation à vie, l'évaluation de la fiabilité et la maintenance prédictive éclairée par la physique. Ce poste de PhD fait partie d'une subvention ERC Consolidator, appuyant la recherche de pointe sur l'IA, la maintenance intelligente et la modélisation des processus de dégradation dans des systèmes complexes. Profil Nous sommes à la recherche d'un candidat au doctorat ayant une solide expérience analytique et un diplôme de maîtrise en génie mécanique, mécanique informatique, sciences de l'ingénierie, physique, mathématiques appliquées, ou un domaine étroitement lié. Vous devriez avoir une base solide dans l'apprentissage automatique (p. ex., l'apprentissage profond) et la modélisation mathématique, y compris l'expérience avec les systèmes dynamiques ou les équations différentielles. On s'attend à un vif intérêt pour la modélisation des systèmes physiques et des processus de dégradation (p. ex. fatigue, accumulation de dommages). L'expérience des réseaux neuronaux graphiques ou des modèles spatiotemporels est hautement souhaitable, ainsi que la connaissance des approches fondées sur la physique qui intègrent le biais inductif physique dans les modèles d'apprentissage. La connaissance d'un ou de plusieurs des domaines suivants est considérée comme un atout important :
• Approches d'apprentissage par machine et de modélisation hybride
• Mécanique computationnelle, dynamique structurelle ou modélisation de fatigue et de dommages
• Traitement et analyse des données de mesure des systèmes physiques
• Apprentissage scientifique par machine ou méthodes numériques pour les systèmes physiques De solides compétences en programmation et la capacité de travailler à l'interface de l'apprentissage automatique et de la modélisation physique des systèmes d'ingénierie sont attendues. Nous nous attendons à ce que le candidat soit autodidacte, avec de solides capacités de résolution de problèmes et une pensée hors du commun. Le commandement professionnel de l'anglais (écrit et parlé) est obligatoire. Environnement de travail L'EPFL est l'un des campus universitaires les plus dynamiques d'Europe, figure parmi les 20 meilleures universités au monde et offre un environnement de travail exceptionnel avec des salaires très compétitifs. Le laboratoire IMOS (https://www.epfl.ch/labs/imos/ ) offre un environnement scientifique interdisciplinaire très motivant, offrant de nombreuses possibilités d'interagir entre les projets et les chercheurs, et maintient un excellent réseau

jobs.description:
Mission

EPFL (École Polytechnique Fédérale de Lausanne) is one of Europe's most dynamic and international research universities, consistently ranked among the world's top institutions. With over 16,000 students and staff from more than 120 countries, EPFL offers an inspiring environment fostering excellence in education, research, and innovation.
Our laboratory develops and applies advanced molecular and optical technologies to study mechanisms of cell surface signaling, cancer neuroscience, and protein engineering, integrating molecular biology, cell biology, and systems neuroscience approaches. To support our expanding in vivo and ex vivo neuroscience program, we are seeking a motivated and experienced technician to assist with mouse work, surgical procedures, and primary neuron culture.

Main duties and responsibilities

• Mouse husbandry and colony management: Maintain and manage mouse colonies, including breeding, genotyping, weaning, and record-keeping in compliance with EPFL and Swiss animal welfare regulations.
• Surgical procedures: Perform stereotaxic surgeries (e.g., viral injections, cannula implantations, cranial window preparations) under the supervision of senior lab members and in accordance with approved animal protocols.
• Primary neuron culture: Prepare and maintain primary neuronal cultures (cortical, hippocampal, or other CNS neurons), including dissection, dissociation, plating, and routine maintenance.
• General laboratory support: Maintain overall lab organization, including ordering and inventory management, preparation of buffers and reagents, autoclaving, and waste management.
• Safety and compliance: Ensure strict adherence to EPFL biosafety and animal welfare guidelines; assist in training new lab members on animal handling and surgical procedures
• Equipment maintenance: Maintain surgical instruments and relevant laboratory equipment in good working condition; coordinate servicing and calibration as required.

Profile

Required qualifications
• BSc or MSc in neuroscience, biology, bioengineering, or a related life science field.
• At least two years of hands-on experience with rodent handling and in vivo mouse work in an academic or industrial research environment.
• Experience with primary neuron isolation and culture (cortical and/or hippocampal neurons preferred).
• Demonstrated experience with stereotaxic surgery or other neurosurgical techniques.
• Valid Swiss/European animal experimentation license
• Excellent attention to detail, organizational skills, and ability to work both independently and collaboratively in an international, multidisciplinary team.
• Fluency in English and French.

Desirable qualifications
• Experience with viral vector handling (AAV, lentivirus) for in vivo or in vitro applications.
• Familiarity with basic histology (perfusion, sectioning, immunostaining).
• Experience with fluorescence microscopy or calcium imaging

We offer

• A stimulating position at one of the world’s top research universities.
• A dynamic, diverse, and collaborative working environment at the intersection of molecular biology, neuroscience, and engineering.
• Opportunities for professional development, including language and technical training courses.
• Family-friendly policies and flexible work arrangements supporting work–life balance.

Informations

Contract Start Date : As soon as possible

Activity Rate : 50-100% (negotiable)

Contract Type: CDD

Duration: 1 year renewable

Reference: 2200

Il nostro laboratorio sviluppa e applica tecnologie molecolari e ottiche avanzate per studiare i meccanismi di segnalazione delle superfici cellulari, neuroscienze tumorali e ingegneria delle proteine, integrando la biologia molecolare, la biologia cellulare e sistemi di neuroscienze approcci. Per sostenere il nostro programma di neuroscienze in vivo ed ex vivo, stiamo cercando un tecnico motivato ed esperto per aiutare con il lavoro del mouse, le procedure chirurgiche e la cultura neuronale primaria. descriptionByLocale.en:
Mission

EPFL (École Polytechnique Fédérale de Lausanne) is one of Europe's most dynamic and international research universities, consistently ranked among the world's top institutions. With over 16,000 students and staff from more than 120 countries, EPFL offers an inspiring environment fostering excellence in education, research, and innovation.
Our laboratory develops and applies advanced molecular and optical technologies to study mechanisms of cell surface signaling, cancer neuroscience, and protein engineering, integrating molecular biology, cell biology, and systems neuroscience approaches. To support our expanding in vivo and ex vivo neuroscience program, we are seeking a motivated and experienced technician to assist with mouse work, surgical procedures, and primary neuron culture.

Main duties and responsibilities

• Mouse husbandry and colony management: Maintain and manage mouse colonies, including breeding, genotyping, weaning, and record-keeping in compliance with EPFL and Swiss animal welfare regulations.
• Surgical procedures: Perform stereotaxic surgeries (e.g., viral injections, cannula implantations, cranial window preparations) under the supervision of senior lab members and in accordance with approved animal protocols.
• Primary neuron culture: Prepare and maintain primary neuronal cultures (cortical, hippocampal, or other CNS neurons), including dissection, dissociation, plating, and routine maintenance.
• General laboratory support: Maintain overall lab organization, including ordering and inventory management, preparation of buffers and reagents, autoclaving, and waste management.
• Safety and compliance: Ensure strict adherence to EPFL biosafety and animal welfare guidelines; assist in training new lab members on animal handling and surgical procedures
• Equipment maintenance: Maintain surgical instruments and relevant laboratory equipment in good working condition; coordinate servicing and calibration as required.

Profile

Required qualifications
• BSc or MSc in neuroscience, biology, bioengineering, or a related life science field.
• At least two years of hands-on experience with rodent handling and in vivo mouse work in an academic or industrial research environment.
• Experience with primary neuron isolation and culture (cortical and/or hippocampal neurons preferred).
• Demonstrated experience with stereotaxic surgery or other neurosurgical techniques.
• Valid Swiss/European animal experimentation license
• Excellent attention to detail, organizational skills, and ability to work both independently and collaboratively in an international, multidisciplinary team.
• Fluency in English and French.

Desirable qualifications
• Experience with viral vector handling (AAV, lentivirus) for in vivo or in vitro applications.
• Familiarity with basic histology (perfusion, sectioning, immunostaining).
• Experience with fluorescence microscopy or calcium imaging

We offer

• A stimulating position at one of the world’s top research universities.
• A dynamic, diverse, and collaborative working environment at the intersection of molecular biology, neuroscience, and engineering.
• Opportunities for professional development, including language and technical training courses.
• Family-friendly policies and flexible work arrangements supporting work–life balance.

Informations

Contract Start Date : As soon as possible

Activity Rate : 50-100% (negotiable)

Contract Type: CDD

Duration: 1 year renewable

Reference: 2200

Only application submitted via the online platform will be considered.

For additional information please contact Dr. Yoon Kim (yoon.kim@epfl.ch)

Um unser expandierendes In-vivo- und Ex-vivo-Neurowissenschaftsprogramm zu unterstützen, suchen wir einen motivierten und erfahrenen Techniker, der bei der Arbeit mit Mäusen, chirurgischen Eingriffen und der primären Neuronenkultur hilft. jobs.description:
Mission

• EPFL, the Swiss Federal Institute of Technology in Lausanne, is one of the most dynamic university campuses in Europe and ranks among the top 20 universities worldwide.

• EPFL’s School of Engineering is now looking for an IT Support Technician to join their IT support team onsite at EPFL’s Lausanne campus, with occasional work taking also place at the EPFL Neuchâtel campus.

Main duties and responsibilities

• IT support: You will join a small, collaborative IT support team with structured onboarding and team support, enabling you to deliver IT support to onsite and remote users either in person, or via emails, tickets, and calls, resolving both basic and progressively more complex issues.

• Hardware management: Assist clients in IT equipment purchasing and deployments (Windows, macOS, Linux) using fleet management and other tools. Diagnose and resolve hardware issues.

• Unified communications: Provide support for videoconferencing tools, rooms and events.

• IT classroom support: Set up and troubleshoot IT equipment and applications in IT classrooms.

• Software support and patch management: Install and configure software, troubleshoot application-related issues and manage IT software updates for end-user machines.

• Network access: Manage client access to the EPFL network and resolve connectivity issues.

• Documentation: Actively maintain the IT documentation - both internal and client facing - as part of the support team’s responsibilities.

• IT projects: Participate in IT infrastructure upgrades, migrations, and faculty-wide rollouts.

• Security: Contribute to IT security by taking care of hardware and software lifecycle.

Profile

Required qualifications:

• Experience in IT support with a strong customer service approach.

• Familiarity with IT support ticket management systems (e.g. ServiceNow).

• Proficiency in deploying, managing and troubleshooting at least two of the following operating systems: Linux, macOS or Windows.

• Experience with IT hardware management (laptops, workstations, PC components).

• Experience with AV and videoconferencing tools (e.g., Zoom, Teams).

• Knowledge of concepts such as Active Directory, LDAP, and GPO.

• Good knowledge of networking fundamentals (e.g. IP addressing, firewalls, port openings, VPN).

Nice-to-have qualifications:

• Experience in scripting (e.g. Linux: bash; or Windows: batch/powershell) or in programming languages and tools (e.g. Python, git).

• Knowledge of ITIL or similar industry best practices (incident / change management).

Your Profile:

• Bachelors in Computer Science or CFC, with at least 3-5 years of working in the IT field.

• Customer-focused, easy to approach, calm and flexible mindset: you enjoy working with people.

• You enjoy troubleshooting problems and juggling different requests in a dynamic environment.

• Willingness to support events occasionally outside regular hours.

• Fluent in French and English; verbal and written.

• Motivated, team-oriented and ability to meet deadlines.

• Detail-oriented with a commitment to continuous learning and team collaboration.

We offer

• Full-time permanent position according to Swiss federal salary scales.

• Work at a world-class institution ranked in the global top 10 for engineering and technology.

• Exposure to a diverse and technically rich environment supporting researchers, engineers, and students at the forefront of science and technology.

• Opportunities to grow into more specialized roles (systems, endpoint management, automation) depending on interest and performance.

• Diverse, multicultural working environment.

• Family-friendly policies, including child and education allowances.

• Discounts for public transport and car sharing services at reduced prices.

Further information:

• Work location: Primary work location is EPFL’s Lausanne campus. The role requires periodic presence also at EPFL Neuchâtel campus, based on client demand; travel costs are compensated acc

descriptionByLocale.it:
Missione
• EPFL, l'Istituto federale di tecnologia svizzero di Losanna, è uno dei campus universitari più dinamici d'Europa e si colloca tra le prime 20 università di tutto il mondo.
• EPFL’s School of Engineering è ora alla ricerca di un tecnico di supporto IT per unirsi al loro team di supporto IT in loco presso il campus di Lausanne di EPFL, con occasionali lavori che si svolgono anche presso il campus EPFL Neuchâtel. Principali doveri e responsabilità
• Supporto IT: Ti unirai a un piccolo team di supporto IT collaborativo con supporto di bordo e team strutturato, che ti permetterà di fornire supporto IT a utenti in loco e remoti sia di persona, sia via e-mail, biglietti e chiamate, risolvendo problemi sia di base che progressivamente più complessi.
• Gestione hardware: Assist i client nell'acquisto e distribuzione di attrezzature IT (Windows, macOS, Linux) utilizzando la gestione della flotta e altri strumenti. Diagnosi e risoluzione dei problemi hardware.
• Comunicazioni unificate: fornire supporto per strumenti di videoconferenza, camere ed eventi.
• Supporto in classe IT: Impostare e risolvere i problemi di attrezzature e applicazioni IT in aule IT.
• Supporto software e gestione delle patch: installare e configurare software, risolvere problemi relativi alle applicazioni e gestire gli aggiornamenti software IT per le macchine dell'utente finale.
• Accesso alla rete: Gestire l'accesso del cliente alla rete EPFL e risolvere i problemi di connettività.
• Documentazione: Mantenere attivamente la documentazione IT - sia interna che clienti - come parte delle responsabilità del team di supporto.
• Progetti IT: Partecipare agli aggiornamenti delle infrastrutture IT, alle migrazioni e ai rollout a livello di facoltà.
• Sicurezza: Contribuisci alla sicurezza IT prendendosi cura del ciclo di vita hardware e software. Profilo qualifiche richieste:
• Esperienza nel supporto IT con un forte approccio al servizio clienti.
• Familiarità con i sistemi di gestione dei biglietti di supporto IT (ad esempio ServiceNow).
• Competenza nella distribuzione, gestione e risoluzione dei problemi almeno due dei seguenti sistemi operativi: Linux, macOS o Windows.
• Esperienza con la gestione hardware IT (laptop, workstation, componenti PC).
• Esperienza con strumenti AV e videoconferenze (ad esempio, Zoom, Teams).
• Conoscenza di concetti come Active Directory, LDAP e GPO.
• Buona conoscenza dei fondamenti di rete (ad esempio indirizzo IP, firewall, aperture portuali, VPN). Competenze:
• Esperienza nello scripting (ad esempio Linux: bash; o Windows: batch/powershell) o in linguaggi e strumenti di programmazione (ad esempio Python, git).
• Conoscenza delle best practice ITIL o del settore simile (gestione incidente / cambiamento). Il tuo profilo:
• Bachelor in Informatica o CFC, con almeno 3-5 anni di lavoro nel campo IT.
• mentalità orientata al cliente, facile da avvicinare, calma e flessibile: ti piace lavorare con le persone.
• Ti piace risolvere i problemi e risolvere diverse richieste in un ambiente dinamico.
• Volontà di sostenere eventi occasionalmente fuori orario regolare.
• Fluente in francese e inglese; verbale e scritto.
• Motivato, team-oriented e la capacità di soddisfare le scadenze.
• Dettaglio orientato con l'impegno di apprendimento continuo e collaborazione di team. Offriamo
• Posizione permanente a tempo pieno secondo le scale salariali federali svizzere.
• Lavorare in un istituto di livello mondiale classificato nella top 10 globale per l'ingegneria e la tecnologia.
• Esposizione a un ambiente diversificato e tecnicamente ricco che sostiene ricercatori, ingegneri e studenti all'avanguardia della scienza e della tecnologia.
• Opportunità di crescere in ruoli più specializzati (sistemi, gestione endpoint, automazione) a seconda degli interessi e delle prestazioni.
• Ambiente di lavoro diverso e multiculturale.
• Politiche a favore della famiglia, comprese le indennità per l'infanzia e l'istruzione.
• Sconti per i servizi di trasporto pubblico e di car sharing a prezzi ridotti. Ulteriori informazioni:
• Luogo di lavoro: La posizione del lavoro primario è il campus di Lausanne di EPFL. Il ruolo richiede una presenza periodica anche al campus EPFL Neuchâtel, basato sulla domanda del cliente; i costi di viaggio sono compensati

• L'École d'Ingénierie de l'EPFL est à la recherche d'un technicien de support informatique pour rejoindre son équipe de support informatique sur le campus de Lausanne de l'EPFL, avec des travaux occasionnels sur le campus de Neuchâtel de l'EPFL. Principales fonctions et responsabilités
• Support informatique : vous rejoindrez une petite équipe collaborative de support informatique avec une structure d'accueil et de soutien d'équipe, vous permettant de fournir un support informatique aux utilisateurs sur place et à distance soit en personne, soit par e-mail, tickets et appels, en résolvant les problèmes de base et progressivement plus complexes.
• Gestion du matériel: Aider les clients dans l'achat et le déploiement de matériel informatique (Windows, macOS, Linux) en utilisant la gestion de flotte et d'autres outils. Diagnostiquer et résoudre les problèmes matériels.
• Communications unifiées : fournir un appui pour les outils, salles et événements de vidéoconférence.
• Support de la salle de classe informatique : Installez et dépannez les équipements et applications informatiques dans les salles de classe informatiques.
• Assistance logicielle et gestion des patchs : Installez et configurez des logiciels, dépannez les problèmes d'application et gérez les mises à jour des logiciels informatiques pour les utilisateurs finaux.
• Accès réseau : gérer l'accès client au réseau de l'EPFL et résoudre les problèmes de connectivité.
• Documentation: Maintenir activement la documentation informatique - interne et client - dans le cadre des responsabilités de l'équipe de soutien.
• Projets informatiques : participer à la modernisation de l'infrastructure informatique, aux migrations et aux déploiements dans l'ensemble du corps professoral.
• Sécurité : contribuer à la sécurité informatique en prenant soin du matériel et du cycle de vie des logiciels. Profil Compétences requises:
• Expérience de l'assistance informatique grâce à une solide approche du service à la clientèle.
• Familiarité avec les systèmes de gestion de tickets d'assistance informatique (par exemple ServiceNow).
• Compétence en déploiement, gestion et dépannage d'au moins deux des systèmes d'exploitation suivants : Linux, macOS ou Windows.
• Expérience de la gestion du matériel informatique (ordinateurs portables, postes de travail, composants PC).
• Expérience des outils AV et visioconférence (par exemple Zoom, Équipes).
• Connaissance de concepts comme Active Directory, LDAP et GPO.
• Bonne connaissance des bases de la mise en réseau (par exemple adresse IP, pare-feu, ouverture de port, VPN). Qualifications agréables à posséder:
• Expérience dans le script (par exemple Linux: bash; ou Windows: batch/powershell) ou dans les langages et outils de programmation (par exemple Python, git).

jobs.description:
Mission

The Extreme Environments Research Laboratory ( EERL ) is looking for a research engineer to support and enhance our field and laboratory measurements of atmospheric aerosols, trace gases and clouds. EERL is running several projects in the Arctic and Antarctic, including participation in large international endeavors such as Tara Polar Station and Antarctica InSync . Specifically, we are focused on vertical measurements, with our EERL helikite being the main platform. As payload we deploy both commercially available instruments as well as our own developments. Our newest helikite system (AVATAR) is nearly fully automated, allowing a single operator to handle the system in challenging conditions. We plan to further develop it for large-scale deployment.

The successful candidate will be interested in further developing existing systems as well as developing new ones to push the boundaries of our observational capabilities. They will also have a genuine interest in atmospheric and aerosol sciences, as well as polar regions.

EERL forms part of EPFL’s new Alpine and Polar Environmental Research Centre ( ALPOLE ) of EPFL on the campus in Sion.

For the application via the EPFL recruiting platform, please submit a motivation letter including your interests and qualifications, a CV and – if applicable – a publication list, as well as the contacts of three referees.

The position will be granted initially for two years with a long-term vision. Desired start date is 15 July 2026 or as soon as possible thereafter.

Main duties and responsibilities

• Further develop and maintain the helikite system (winch, board computer, communication/control system, instrument integration in payload) and other custom-made laboratory systems

• Obtain flight permissions

• Design experiments, and contribute with own ideas to new observational and instrumental needs that arise

• Support EERL researchers in maintaining and repairing instrumentation

• Support field logistics

• Participate in field campaigns

• Keep health and safety standards in the laboratory

• Documentation of work and systems

• General contribution to EERL’s activities.

• Participate in student supervision.

• Promote polar research and its impact to the public.

Profile

• MSc in engineering with experience in electrical and mechanical engineering, mechatronics and applied physics

• Skills in analog & digital circuit design, PCB design, embedded systems (ARM, Arduino, STM32), basics in signal processing

• Coding experience (e.g., python, Matlab) and data handling/visualization

• Experience in building prototypes

• Experience in lab work and fixing of instrumentation

• Experience in project management

• Experience in field work is an asset

• Good interpersonal skills, team player.

• Good knowledge of English (written and spoken).

We offer

• A dynamic, interdisciplinary and young research group.

• A vibrant, internationally visible and rising academic institution in alpine and polar environmental research.

• A great working atmosphere and ample opportunities for professional and personal development with access to many continuing education courses.

Informations

Activity Rate Min : 80.00

Activity Rate Max : 100.00

L'EERL sta portando avanti diversi progetti nell'Artico e nell'Antartide, inclusa la partecipazione a grandi iniziative internazionali come la Stazione Polare Tara e l'Antartide InSync. Nello specifico, ci concentriamo sulle misurazioni verticali, con la nostra helikite EERL come piattaforma principale. Come carico utile utilizziamo sia strumenti disponibili in commercio sia i nostri sviluppi. Il nostro nuovissimo sistema Helikite (AVATAR) è quasi completamente automatizzato e consente a un singolo operatore di gestire il sistema in condizioni difficili. Abbiamo in programma di svilupparlo ulteriormente per un’implementazione su larga scala. Il candidato prescelto sarà interessato a sviluppare ulteriormente i sistemi esistenti e a svilupparne di nuovi per ampliare i confini delle nostre capacità di osservazione. Avranno anche un genuino interesse per le scienze dell'atmosfera e dell'aerosol, nonché per le regioni polari. L'EERL fa parte del nuovo Centro di ricerca ambientale alpino e polare ( ALPOLE ) dell'EPFL nel campus di Sion. Per la candidatura tramite la piattaforma di reclutamento dell'EPFL, si prega di inviare una lettera di motivazione che includa i propri interessi e qualifiche, un CV e, se applicabile, un elenco di pubblicazioni, nonché i contatti di tre revisori. La posizione sarà assegnata inizialmente per due anni con una visione a lungo termine. La data di inizio desiderata è il 15 luglio 2026 o il più presto possibile successivamente. Principali compiti e responsabilità • Sviluppare e mantenere ulteriormente il sistema helikite (verricello, computer di bordo, sistema di comunicazione/controllo, integrazione degli strumenti nel carico utile) e altri sistemi di laboratorio personalizzati • Ottenere permessi di volo • Progettare esperimenti e contribuire con le proprie idee alle nuove esigenze osservative e strumentali che si presentano • Supportare i ricercatori dell'EERL nella manutenzione e riparazione della strumentazione • Supportare la logistica sul campo • Partecipare a campagne sul campo • Mantenere gli standard di salute e sicurezza in laboratorio • Documentazione del lavoro e dei sistemi • Contributo generale alle attività dell'EERL. • Partecipare alla supervisione degli studenti. • Promuovere la ricerca polare e il suo impatto presso il pubblico. Profilo • Master in ingegneria con esperienza in ingegneria elettrica e meccanica, meccatronica e fisica applicata • Competenze nella progettazione di circuiti analogici e digitali, progettazione PCB, sistemi embedded (ARM, Arduino, STM32), nozioni di base nell'elaborazione del segnale • Esperienza di codifica (ad es. Python, Matlab) e gestione/visualizzazione dei dati • Esperienza nella costruzione di prototipi • Esperienza nel lavoro di laboratorio e nel fissaggio della strumentazione • Esperienza nella gestione di progetti • L'esperienza nel lavoro sul campo è un vantaggio • Buone capacità interpersonali, giocatore di squadra. • Buona conoscenza della lingua inglese (scritta e parlata). Offriamo • Un gruppo di ricerca dinamico, interdisciplinare e giovane. • Un'istituzione accademica vivace, visibile a livello internazionale e in crescita nel campo della ricerca ambientale alpina e polare. • Un'ottima atmosfera lavorativa e ampie opportunità di sviluppo professionale e personale con accesso a numerosi corsi di formazione continua. descriptionByLocale.de: Mission Das Extreme Environments Research Laboratory (EERL) sucht einen Forschungsingenieur zur Unterstützung und Verbesserung unserer Feld- und Labormessungen von atmosphärischen Aerosolen, Spurengasen und Wolken. EERL führt mehrere Projekte in der Arktis und Antarktis durch, darunter die Beteiligung an großen internationalen Projekten wie der Tara Polar Station und Antarctica InSync. Wir konzentrieren uns insbesondere auf vertikale Messungen, wobei unser EERL-Helikite die Hauptplattform ist. Als Nutzlast setzen wir sowohl kommerziell erhältliche Instrumente als auch eigene Entwicklungen ein. Unser neuestes Helikite-System (AVATAR) ist nahezu vollständig automatisiert, sodass ein einziger Bediener das System unter schwierigen Bedingungen bedienen kann. Wir planen, es für den Einsatz in großem Maßstab weiterzuentwickeln. Der erfolgreiche Kandidat wird daran interessiert sein, bestehende Systeme weiterzuentwickeln und neue zu entwickeln, um die Grenzen unserer Beobachtungsfähigkeiten zu erweitern. Sie werden auch ein echtes Interesse an den Atmosphären- und Aerosolwissenschaften sowie den Polarregionen haben. EERL ist Teil des neuen Alpinen und Polaren Umweltforschungszentrums (ALPOLE) der EPFL auf dem Campus in Sion. Für die Bewerbung über die Rekrutierungsplattform der EPFL reichen Sie bitte ein Motivationsschreiben mit Ihren Interessen und Qualifikationen, einen Lebenslauf und ggf. eine Publikationsliste sowie die Kontakte von drei Gutachtern ein. Die Stelle wird zunächst für zwei Jahre mit einer langfristigen Ausrichtung vergeben. Gewünschter Starttermin ist der 15. Juli 2026 oder so bald wie möglich danach. Hauptaufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten • Weiterentwicklung und Wartung des Helikite-Systems (Winde, Bordcomputer, Kommunikations-/Steuerungssystem, Instrumentenintegration in der Nutzlast) und anderer maßgeschneiderter Laborsysteme • Einholen von Fluggenehmigungen • Entwerfen von Experimenten und Mitwirken mit eigenen Ideen an neuen Beobachtungs- und Instrumentenbedürfnissen, die entstehen • Unterstützen Sie EERL-Forscher bei der Wartung und Reparatur von Instrumenten Aktivitäten. • Nehmen Sie an der Betreuung der Studierenden teil. • Förderung der Polarforschung und ihrer Auswirkungen auf die Öffentlichkeit. Profil • MSc in Ingenieurwissenschaften mit Erfahrung in Elektrotechnik und Maschinenbau, Mechatronik und angewandter Physik • Kenntnisse im analogen und digitalen Schaltungsdesign, PCB-Design, eingebetteten Systemen (ARM, Arduino, STM32), Grundlagen der Signalverarbeitung • Programmiererfahrung (z. B. Python, Matlab) und Datenverarbeitung/-visualisierung • Erfahrung im Bau von Prototypen • Erfahrung in Laborarbeit und Reparatur von Instrumenten • Erfahrung im Projektmanagement • Erfahrung in der Feldarbeit ist von Vorteil • Gute zwischenmenschliche Fähigkeiten, Teamplayer. • Gute Englischkenntnisse (schriftlich und mündlich). Wir bieten: • Eine dynamische, interdisziplinäre und junge Forschungsgruppe. • Eine lebendige, international sichtbare und aufstrebende akademische Einrichtung in der alpinen und polaren Umweltforschung. • Ein tolles Arbeitsklima und vielfältige Möglichkeiten zur beruflichen und persönlichen Weiterentwicklung mit Zugang zu zahlreichen Weiterbildungsangeboten. descriptionByLocale.fr: Mission Le Laboratoire de recherche sur les environnements extrêmes ( EERL ) est à la recherche d'un ingénieur de recherche pour soutenir et améliorer nos mesures sur le terrain et en laboratoire des aérosols atmosphériques, des gaz traces et des nuages. L'EERL mène plusieurs projets dans l'Arctique et l'Antarctique, notamment en participant à de grands projets internationaux tels que Tara Polar Station et Antarctica InSync. Plus précisément, nous nous concentrons sur les mesures verticales, notre hélikite EERL étant la plate-forme principale. En tant que charge utile, nous déployons à la fois des instruments disponibles dans le commerce ainsi que nos propres développements. Notre tout nouveau système d'hélikite (AVATAR) est presque entièrement automatisé, permettant à un seul opérateur de gérer le système dans des conditions difficiles. Nous prévoyons de le développer davantage pour un déploiement à grande échelle. Le candidat retenu sera intéressé à développer davantage les systèmes existants ainsi qu’à en développer de nouveaux pour repousser les limites de nos capacités d’observation. Ils auront également un réel intérêt pour les sciences de l'atmosphère et des aérosols, ainsi que pour les régions polaires. L'EERL fait partie du nouveau Centre de recherche sur l'environnement alpin et polaire ( ALPOLE ) de l'EPFL, sur le campus de Sion. Pour postuler via la plateforme de recrutement de l'EPFL, veuillez soumettre une lettre de motivation comprenant vos intérêts et qualifications, un CV et – le cas échéant – une liste de publications, ainsi que les contacts de trois filleuls. Le poste sera accordé dans un premier temps pour deux ans avec une vision à long terme. La date de début souhaitée est le 15 juillet 2026 ou dès que possible par la suite. Principales tâches et responsabilités • Développer et entretenir le système Helikite (treuil, ordinateur de bord, système de communication/contrôle, intégration d'instruments dans la charge utile) et d'autres systèmes de laboratoire sur mesure. • Obtenir les autorisations de vol. • Concevoir des expériences et contribuer avec ses propres idées aux nouveaux besoins d'observation et d'instruments qui se présentent. • Participer à l'encadrement des étudiants. • Promouvoir la recherche polaire et son impact auprès du public. Profil • MSc en ingénierie avec expérience en génie électrique et mécanique, mécatronique et physique appliquée • Compétences en conception de circuits analogiques et numériques, conception de PCB, systèmes embarqués (ARM, Arduino, STM32), bases en traitement du signal • Expérience en codage (par exemple, python, Matlab) et manipulation/visualisation de données • Expérience en construction de prototypes • Expérience en travail de laboratoire et en réparation d'instrumentation • Expérience en gestion de projet • L'expérience en travail sur le terrain est un atout • Bonnes compétences interpersonnelles, esprit d'équipe. • Bonne connaissance de l'anglais (écrit et parlé). Nous vous proposons • Un groupe de recherche dynamique, interdisciplinaire et jeune. • Une institution universitaire dynamique, en plein essor et visible à l'échelle internationale, dans le domaine de la recherche environnementale alpine et polaire. • Une excellente ambiance de travail et de nombreuses opportunités de développement professionnel et personnel avec accès à de nombreux cours de formation continue. L’EPFL (École polytechnique fédérale de Lausanne), est l'un des campus universitaires les plus dynamiques d'Europe et s'inscrit dans le top 20 mondial de nombreux classements académiques. L'EPFL compte plus de 6'500 membres du personnel qui font vivre les trois missions principales de l'École : l'éducation, la recherche et l'innovation. Le campus de l'EPFL offre un cadre de travail exceptionnel au cœur d'une communauté de plus de 18'000 personnes, dont près de 12'500 étudiant-e-s et 4'000 chercheur-euse-s issu-e-s de plus de 120 nationalités différentes

descriptionByLocale.it: Missione Per la posizione 1 PhD a partire dal 2026 estate (flessibile) , stiamo cercando un candidato con esperienza in materiali iontronic . Esempi includono materiali soffici, biomateriali, idrogels, organogels, organoidrogels, polimeri conduttivi, elastomeri ionici e liquidi ionici, tra gli altri. Il candidato dovrebbe essere interessato a settori emergenti, interdisciplinari ed essere motivato ad affrontare nuove sfide, tra cui lo sviluppo di (1) dispositivi iontronic, (2) soft material manufacturing , e (3) biointerfaces . Leader del gruppo e missione di ricerca: Prof. Yujia Zhang Al Laboratorio di Bio-Iontronics (BION ) la nostra missione è quella di realizzare sistemi bioiontronici per biointerfacce e sistemi intelligenti ibridi. A tal fine, siamo interessati a sviluppare sistemi iontronici a base di goccia, denominati dropletronics, con funzioni chiave di energia incorporata, controllo della logica, reattività stimolante e consegna terapeutica, consentendo la comunicazione interattiva con la biologia. Il sistema dropletronic sarà formato da reti goccioline picoliter stampate tridimensionalmente (3D) che utilizzano bilayer lipidi, nanopori funzionali e soluti selettivi a carica per consentire un sofisticato controllo ionico. Principali doveri e responsabilità In qualità di Dottorato di Ricerca, ci si aspetta che: • Abbiate piena responsabilità per la vostra dissertazione; • Ricerca in stretta collaborazione con altri membri del laboratorio e collaboratori internazionali; • Progettazione e esecuzione sperimentale; • Analizzare e interpretare i risultati sperimentali; • Scrivere articoli scientifici per la pubblicazione in riviste peer-reviewed; • Presente a conferenze internazionali; • Supervise progetti per studenti e supporto amministrativo di base. Profilo • MSc in scienze dei materiali, microingegneria, o bioingegneria; • Esperienza con caratterizzazione dei polimeri; • Esperienza prioritaria nella produzione di cleanroom e stampa 3D è un plus; • Forte capacità sperimentali e una mentalità pratica e pratica; • Alto livello di motivazione per la ricerca accademica interdisciplinare; • Indipendente, auto-driven, creativo, orientata alla soluzione, open-minded, team-player e collaborativo; Offriamo • 4 anni per completare il dottorato con una remunerazione competitiva; • collaborazioni internazionali e opportunità di visita; • EPFL è un istituto di ingegneria internazionale e di livello mondiale che ospita strutture sperimentali all'avanguardia e una ricca e vivace comunità scientifica e imprenditoriale; • Termine di lavoro: contratto a tempo determinato di 1 anno (CDD), rinnovabile per 4 anni. Informazioni Vengono considerate solo le applicazioni presentate attraverso la piattaforma online . Si prega di applicare caricando un singolo file PDF che contiene informazioni di supporto, tra cui: • Lettera di motivazione • CV dettagliato • Almeno 2 riferimenti disposti a scrivere lettere di raccomandazione e le loro informazioni di contatto • Termine di richiesta: 02 marzo 2026 Se hai successo, dovrai iscriverti in uno dei programmi di dottorato EPFL . Si prega di controllare questa pagina per ulteriori informazioni. Si prega di notare che questo è un processo di applicazione separato necessario per essere idonei a completare il dottorato in EPFL. descriptionByLocale.de: Mission Für die erste Doktorandenstelle ab Sommer 2026 (flexibel) suchen wir einen Kandidaten mit Erfahrung in iontronischen Materialien. Beispiele hierfür sind unter anderem auf Reize reagierende weiche Materialien, Biomaterialien, Hydrogele, Organogele, Organohydrogele, leitfähige Polymere, ionische Elastomere und ionische Flüssigkeiten. Der Kandidat sollte an neuen, interdisziplinären Bereichen interessiert sein und motiviert sein, sich neuen Herausforderungen zu stellen, einschließlich der Entwicklung von (1) iontronischen Geräten, (2) der Herstellung weicher Materialien und (3) Bioschnittstellen. Gruppenleiter und Forschungsmission: Prof. Yujia Zhang Im Labor für Bioiontronik (BION) ist es unsere Mission, bioiontronische Systeme für Bioschnittstellen und hybride intelligente Systeme herzustellen. Zu diesem Zweck sind wir an der Entwicklung tröpfchenbasierter iontronischer Systeme interessiert, die als Dropletronik bezeichnet werden und über Schlüsselfunktionen der verkörperten Energie, der logischen Kontrolle, der Reaktionsfähigkeit auf Reize und der therapeutischen Abgabe verfügen und eine interaktive Kommunikation mit der Biologie ermöglichen. Das dropletronische System wird aus dreidimensional (3D) gedruckten Picoliter-Tröpfchennetzwerken gebildet, die Lipiddoppelschichten, funktionelle Nanoporen und ladungsselektive gelöste Stoffe nutzen, um eine anspruchsvolle Ionenkontrolle zu ermöglichen. Wir bieten • 4 Jahre Zeit, um Ihre Promotion mit einer wettbewerbsfähigen Vergütung abzuschließen; • Internationale Zusammenarbeit und Besuchsmöglichkeiten; • Die EPFL ist eine internationale und erstklassige Ingenieurinstitution, die über hochmoderne Versuchsanlagen und eine reiche und lebendige wissenschaftliche und unternehmerische Gemeinschaft verfügt; • Beschäftigungsdauer: 1-jähriger befristeter Vertrag (CDD), verlängerbar um 4 Jahre. descriptionByLocale.fr: Mission Pour le 1er doctorat à partir de 2026 été (flexible) , nous recherchons un candidat avec une expérience en matériaux ioniques . Il s'agit, entre autres, de matériaux souples sensibles aux stimuli, de biomatériaux, d'hydrogels, d'organogels, d'organohydrogels, de polymères conducteurs, d'élastomères ioniques et de liquides ioniques. jobs.description:
Mission

We are offering a position as mechanical engineer in the Group of Energy Materials at EPFL, Sion. Our highly interdisciplinary Lab (20 FTE, 1/3rd PhD students, 1/3rd postdocs, 1/3rd engineers) is part of the EPFL Mechanical Engineering Institute and specialised since 30 years in fuel cell and electrolysers, especially for high temperature (>600°C, solid oxide ceramics) and more recently also for low temperature ( We look to complement our engineer team. We design and build stacks, and different customized test benches to characterize our fuel cells, electrolysers, and more complex integrated systems including heat exchangers, chemical reactors, gas recirculation, safety sensors etc.

We are specifically looking for an additional mechanical engineer with a solid experience in computational fluid dynamics and structural mechanics. These competences will be applied during the design of low and high temperature fuel cells and electrolysers, including their balance of plants, under pressurized conditions.

Main duties and responsibilities

More specifically, within our ongoing projects, you will:

• help to finalize our main demonstration installation (10/30 kW full seasonal storage)

• help to construct our 30 kW chemical reactor (20 bar)

• deal with compression of H2, CO2, syngas (20-30 bar), and natural gas grid injection (5 bar)

• manage a 100-kW Power-to-Methane project including a novel electrolyser unit

• maintain and modify existing test benches

• support the design of new test benches (up to 30-50 kW / 50 bar)

• participate in the design of pressurised fuel cell / electrolyser concepts

Profile

• MSc degree in Mechanical Engineering

• Prior professional experience with process flow diagrams, P&ID and HAZOP.

• Prior professional experience with pressurization.

• Prior familiarity with fuel cells, electrolysers, chemical reactors is a plus but not a must.

• Good communication skills and working as part of a team

• Enthusiasm, curiosity, motivation, reactivity, organizational skills, rigor in experimental work

• At least good command of English and preferably also of French (though not mandatory for French)

We offer

• Employment at a renowned institution ranked among the leaders in engineering and technology

• Support for professional development through training and continuous learning opportunities

• Supportive and flexible work environment promoting work-life balance

• Language courses relevant to your role

• International multilingual working environment

• Discounts on public transport

Informations

Your application should contain:

• A motivation letter
• Your detailed CV
• Contact information

• Names and contact information of 2 or more references willing to write a recommendation letter

Application deadline: Apr 15th 2026
Contract Start Date: June 1st 2026 or as per mutual agreement

Activity Rate Min: 80%
Activity Rate Max: 100%
Contract Type: yearly renewed
Duration: up to 5 years

Only applications submitted through the online platform are considered.

For more information, please contact: jan.vanherle@epfl.ch, romain.jordan@epfl.ch, thibault.macherel@epfl.ch, sinclair.augereau@epfl.ch, chantal.donaghey@epfl.ch

descriptionByLocale.en:
Mission

We are offering a position as mechanical engineer in the Group of Energy Materials at EPFL, Sion. Our highly interdisciplinary Lab (20 FTE, 1/3rd PhD students, 1/3rd postdocs, 1/3rd engineers) is part of the EPFL Mechanical Engineering Institute and specialised since 30 years in fuel cell and electrolysers, especially for high temperature (>600°C, solid oxide ceramics) and more recently also for low temperature ( We look to complement our engineer team. We design and build stacks, and different customized test benches to characterize our fuel cells, electrolysers, and more complex integrated systems including heat exchangers, chemical reactors, gas recirculation, safety sensors etc.

We are specifically looking for an additional mechanical engineer with a solid experience in computational fluid dynamics and structural mechanics. These competences will be applied during the design of low and high temperature fuel cells and electrolysers, including their balance of plants, under pressurized conditions.

Main duties and responsibilities

More specifically, within our ongoing projects, you will:

• help to finalize our main demonstration installation (10/30 kW full seasonal storage)

• help to construct our 30 kW chemical reactor (20 bar)

• deal with compression of H2, CO2, syngas (20-30 bar), and natural gas grid injection (5 bar)

• manage a 100-kW Power-to-Methane project including a novel electrolyser unit

• maintain and modify existing test benches

• support the design of new test benches (up to 30-50 kW / 50 bar)

• participate in the design of pressurised fuel cell / electrolyser concepts

Profile

• MSc degree in Mechanical Engineering

• Prior professional experience with process flow diagrams, P&ID and HAZOP.

• Prior professional experience with pressurization.

• Prior familiarity with fuel cells, electrolysers, chemical reactors is a plus but not a must.

• Good communication skills and working as part of a team

• Enthusiasm, curiosity, motivation, reactivity, organizational skills, rigor in experimental work

• At least good command of English and preferably also of French (though not mandatory for French)

We offer

• Employment at a renowned institution ranked among the leaders in engineering and technology

• Support for professional development through training and continuous learning opportunities

• Supportive and flexible work environment promoting work-life balance

• Language courses relevant to your role

• International multilingual working environment

• Discounts on public transport

Informations

Your application should contain:

• A motivation letter
• Your detailed CV
• Contact information

• Names and contact information of 2 or more references willing to write a recommendation letter

Application deadline: Apr 15th 2026
Contract Start Date: June 1st 2026 or as per mutual agreement

Activity Rate Min: 80%
Activity Rate Max: 100%
Contract Type: yearly renewed
Duration: up to 5 years

Only applications submitted through the online platform are considered.

For more information, please contact: jan.vanherle@epfl.ch, romain.jordan@epfl.ch, thibault.macherel@epfl.ch, sinclair.augereau@epfl.ch, chantal.donaghey@epfl.ch

jobs.description:
Mission

The Center for Digital Trust (C4DT) , housed at EPFL, brings together businesses, research community, civil society, and policy actors to collaborate, share insight, shape the research agenda, and to gain early access to trust-­building technologies.

C4DT develops the expertise, methods, and software to enhance privacy, data protection, and transparency; notably by the use of cryptography, blockchains and smart contracts, machine learning, software verification, device and system security. Its research scope covers, among others, finance technologies, health-data security and privacy, technologies for trustworthy governance, democracy, and humanitarian needs.

An important mission of C4DT is to promote innovation and to facilitate technology transfer, by fostering projects between EPFL’s laboratories and our partners. It is where research meets industry requirements.

You will be working on a research grant from Innosuisse on the topic of "Self-recovery of end-to-end encrypted vaults". This work entails helping develop cryptographic algorithms in collaboration with the C4DT team, a laboratory (Professor, PhD students, Research Software Engineers, semester students) writing software libraries and applications, and evaluating them through user tests. The duration of the grant is 2 years.

Main duties and responsibilities

•
Supporting research with experiments and evaluations

•
Writing of libraries and documentation

•
Managing parts of the project

•
Participating in other C4DT related projects (open source services evaluation, server maintenance, workshops organization, …)

Profile

•
Higher education in computer science or equivalent

•
Very good expertise in cryptography: elliptic curves, zero knowledge proofs, post quantum algorithms

•
Interest in the topics of C4DT: digital trust in general, Open Source Software, digital sovereignty

•
Excellent command of several programming languages (Golang, Rust, Typescript), test-driven development, automatic deployment

•
Intelligent use of LLM tools as support for your work, not as replacement

•
Willingness and enthusiasm to learn new technologies

•
Fluency in English, both written and spoken. Working knowledge of French or German is welcome

We offer

•
A small, dynamic and friendly team (fresh bread most Mondays)

•
A stimulating and engineering-focused working environment

•
Integration in larger community of Research Software Engineers

•
An opportunity to develop skills and experience in innovative knowledge transfer and exchange approaches, in a world-class and highly sought-after organization

Informations

Contract Start Date : 08/01/2026

Activity Rate Min : 60.00

Activity Rate Max : 80.00

Contract Type: CDD

Duration: 1 year, renewable

Reference: 2263

• Participation à d'autres projets liés au C4DT (évaluation des services open source, maintenance des serveurs, organisation des ateliers, ...) Profil
• Enseignement supérieur en informatique ou équivalent
• Très bonne expertise en cryptographie: courbes elliptiques, aucune preuve de connaissance, algorithmes post quantiques
• Intérêt pour les sujets de C4DT: confiance numérique en général, Logiciels Open Source, souveraineté numérique
• Excellente maîtrise de plusieurs langages de programmation (Golang, Rust, Typescript), développement piloté par test, déploiement automatique
• Utilisation intelligente des outils LLM comme support pour votre travail, pas comme remplacement
• Volonté et enthousiasme pour apprendre les nouvelles technologies
• Connaissance de l'anglais, écrit et parlé. Une connaissance pratique du français ou de l'allemand est la bienvenue Nous offrons
• Une petite équipe dynamique et amicale (pain frais la plupart des lundis)
• Un environnement de travail stimulant et axé sur l'ingénierie
• Intégration dans une plus grande communauté d'ingénieurs en logiciels de recherche
• Une occasion de développer les compétences et l'expérience en matière de transfert et d'échange de connaissances innovants, dans une organisation de classe mondiale et très recherchée Informations Date de début du contrat : 08/01/2026 Taux d'activité Min : 60.00 Taux d'activité Max : 80.00 Type de contrat: CDD Durée: 1 an, renouvelable Référence: 2263

jobs.description:
Mission

L’EPFL a des défis majeurs en termes de gestion du Système d’Information. Le Domaine des Systèmes d'Information (DSI) est responsable de mettre en œuvre la stratégie numérique de l’EPFL. Ces missions incluent, dans une combinaison de responsabilités directes et de responsabilités matricielles, l'élaboration et mise en œuvre de la stratégie informatique et du plan directeur de l’EPFL, la digitalisation des processus métiers, la sécurité informatique, la gestion des infrastructures informatiques centrales, la gestion des applications cœur-de-métier, ainsi que la coordination avec les services informatiques des Facultés.

Le DSI recherche un·e développeur·euse SAP. La personne titulaire du poste doit être un·e spécialiste dans le domaine du développement d’application ABAP et FIORI. Vous avez pour première mission de nous assister dans la migration (en S/4) de notre ERP. Vous allez aussi garantir la maintenance et l’évolution de la plateforme SAP, pour couvrir les besoins du métier. Vous participez à des projets, en travaillant en partenariat avec les différents services de l'EPFL et autres partenaires externes.

Principales tâches et responsabilités

Votre rôle

• Assurer les développements en ABAP, ABAP OO, RAP, SAPUI5 et JavaScript de tous les types de programmes (Report, BADI, Classes, CDS, FIORI, etc.) possible au sein des systèmes SAP

• Assurer le développement des Workflows

• Utiliser des services SAP BTP

• Assurer le développement des interfaces sur SAP PO

• Paramétrer des outils de gestion des autorisations et de transport d’OT

Conduite ou participation aux projets et activités suivies dans votre domaine d'expertise

• Contribuer à toutes les phases des projets ex : cadrage, conception, réalisation, testing, mise en production, support go live

• Assurer que la documentation technique est réalisée et accessible à l'équipe de développement

• Suivre ou appliquer la méthodologie du projet conformément aux normes de l'EPFL de conduite de projet

• Analyse, paramétrage et implémentation des composants logiciels dans le respect des normes, conventions et best practices en vigueur

Autres tâches

• Élaborer et maintenir la documentation SAP technique

• Assurer une bonne coordination avec les autres domaines fonctionnels et techniques sur le plan des systèmes SAP et/ou en liaison avec SAP

• Transfert de compétences vers les collègues de l’équipe

• Assurer un service conforme aux directives qualités (ex : Hermes, ITIL) et directives d'audit

• Assurer la suppléance d'un·e collègue d'équipe

• Veille technologique : suivre les évolutions technologiques de SAP et évaluer leurs impacts pour le Sl en place à l'EPFL

Maintenance corrective et évolutive dans le cadre du support

• Gérer et coordonner la résolution des tickets (incidents, demandes, évolutions) qui sont attribués à l'équipe, selon les SLA établis, au travers de l'outil de gestion ITSM

• Assurer et gérer l’implémentation des demandes de changement selon la portée, le temps et les ressources convenus avec le métier

• Effectuer les suivis des incidents jusqu'à leur résolution et maintenir le métier informé de l’état d’avancement et de sa résolution

• Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les Service Managers et BRM pour maintenir un bon niveau de service

Profil

• Diplôme supérieur en informatique (HES, Université ou EPF) ou formation jugée équivalente

• SAP - Confirmé : SAP ABAP, ABAP OO, RAP, CDS, SAPUI5 et FIORI (3 années minimum d'expérience)

• Connaissance de SAP Process Orchestration, ChARM et S/4 HANA est un plus

• Expérience dans l’utilisation du Migration Cockpit

• Maitrise des autorisations sur Backend SAP et frontend Fiori

• Grande capacité de synthèse et bonnes aptitudes en communication

• Forte orientation solutions et clients

• Sens aigu du service, à la recherche du dialogue tout en ayant et défendant ses convictions

• Rigueur, précision, proactivité

• Langues : Excellentes connaissances du français (C1) et de l’anglais (

jobs.description:
Mission

Dans le cadre d'un remplacement congé maternité, nous recherchons une ou un Partenaire Expérience Employé·es.

Dans cette fonction, vous interviendrez directement dans la gestion du périmètre attribué pour apporter conseil et soutien à une Vice-Présidence ainsi qu’aux équipes.

Principales tâches et responsabilités

La ou le Partenaire Expérience Employé.es :

- Soutient la Direction du périmètre attribué pour toutes les questions liées à la gestion du personnel

- Participe aux diverses réunions de Direction et avec les membres du personnel pour présenter et les accompagner sur les différents sujets

- Conseille et accompagne des responsables d’unités dans la gestion de leur équipe, en développant les bonnes pratiques managériales

- Selon besoin, participe aux processus de recrutements

- Conseille et accompagne les collaborateurs et collaboratrices tout au long de leur carrière à l’EPFL et répond à leurs questions, par exemple : rémunération, développement, compétences, mobilité interne, évaluations, etc.

- Gère et assure le suivi des situations problématiques liées au personnel

- Soutient les responsables d’unité dans les projets de transformation (réorganisation, fermeture de laboratoires, etc.)

- Pilote les processus annuels tel que révision de salaire, gestion de la performance et développement du personnel, primes, etc.

- Collabore avec les différents pôles d’expertises

- Garantit la mise en application des politiques VPH et des cadres légaux

- Assure le traitement des échéances et questions liées aux employé·es du périmètre (workflows, signature des contrats, etc.)

- Garantit la transparence sur les situations cas complexes et sensibles (cas juridiques, sensibles ou à fort enjeu)

- Contribue activement à des projets internes et transversaux, à des groupes de travail, à des animations d’ateliers dans le but de développer nos processus et prestations

Profil

- Formation universitaire ou HES, avec une spécialisation en Ressources Humaines, ou formation jugée équivalente

- Minimum 5 ans d’expérience dans une fonction analogue avec le même type de responsabilités, au sein d’une grande entreprise ou institution, ainsi que dans la gestion de grandes populations

- Bonnes connaissances des cadres légaux et administratifs RH suisses ; connaissance du droit public représente un atout

- Excellentes compétences de communication orale et écrite, en français et anglais

- Très forte orientation clients et sens relationnel pour créer des partenariats de confiance

- Approche orientée solutions et capacité à prendre des initiatives

- Bienveillance et diplomatie, patience et capacité à gérer des situations complexes

- Capacité d’analyse, de synthèse et de mise en oeuvre de solutions

- Très bonne organisation et excellente capacité à gérer les priorités et le stress

- Capacité à travailler en réseau et esprit d’équipe développé

Nous offrons

- Un environnement de travail stimulant, dynamique et multiculturel au sein du Domaine Expérience Employé·es de notre Vice-Présidence pour le développement humain ( lien )

- Une équipe qui se construit où chaque membre valorise la collaboration, la fluidité des activités et la bienveillance

- Des conditions de travail attractive favorisant l’équilibre, le développement et l'engagement professionnel.

Informations

Date d'entrée en fonction : à convenir

Taux d'occupation min : 80%

Taux d'occupation max : 100%

Type de contrat : CDD

Durée : 6 à 8 mois

Référence : 2189

jobs.description:
Mission

• The Data-Driven Mechanics Laboratory invites applications for a fully funded PhD position at
• the intersection of computational mechanics, multiphysics of geomaterials, and interpretable
• machine learning. The project focuses on the discovery of governing equations and constitutive
• relations for key multiphysics phenomena on the basis of rich micromechanical and
• experimental data. It pushes the boundaries of modeling and understanding crucial processes
• in geomaterials across scales, with application to geophysics, energy and sustainability.

Main roles and responsibilities

• The successful candidate will contribute to a next-generation data-driven framework for
• scientific discovery in geomaterials. Research will involve the development of techniques
• spanning mechanics and AI, including physics-based modeling across scales
• (discrete/mesoscale/continuum), thermodynamics-informed machine learning and
• neurosymbolic AI. They will also have the opportunity to lead international collaborations with
• experimental research groups.

Requirements

• ● Master’s degree in Mechanics, Civil Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Geophysics,
• Applied Mathematics, Computational Science or related areas.
• ● Strong computational/programming skills (Python/C/C++) including computational
• mechanics, and scientific machine learning.
• ● Excellent English communication skills (oral and written).

We offer

• ● World-class multi-cultural environment on the shores of beautiful Lake Leman.
• ● Innovative interdisciplinary research at the Data-Driven Mechanics Lab.
• ● Exceptional research infrastructure and access to world-class computational resources.
• ● Competitive salary and employment conditions.

Informations

• Please email a single PDF consisting of i) a Curriculum vitae (max. 2 pages) with contact details
• of at least 2 referees, ii) Detailed transcripts, and iii) a Motivation letter (max. 1 page), to
• konstantinos.karapiperis@epfl.ch, indicating in the subject “PhD Application LMD – Last Name”
• until July 15th 2026. Applications will be evaluated on a rolling basis in the order that they are
• received. For inquiries please contact Prof. Kostas Karapiperis at the same email.

Contract Start Date: Fall/Winter 2026

Activity Rate : 100.00

Contract Type: One-year renewable contract

Duration: 4 years

Reference: 2267

jobs.description:
Mission

Despite recent technological advances both in the data management and in computer architecture domains, our ability to analyze data still falls behind the unstoppable data collection rates. Data-intensive applications are increasingly more demanding in sophisticated algorithms to store, manage, and interpret data. To meet the challenges, database software needs to communicate efficiently both with the application layer and with the underlying hardware platforms, and deliver seamless computational and data management support. Research in the DIAS lab addresses both aspects of the challenge: we adapt data management technology to computer architecture trends by designing data manipulation techniques that exploit optimally the underlying hardware and I/O devices, and we enable new discoveries in scientific domains through automating physical database design and revolutionizing exploration algorithms in very large data repositories. The DIAS lab pioneers just-in-time query engines which support analytics on raw data, data cleaning and query optimization for heterogeneous distributed data, and hardware/software codesigned engines for demanding applications.

Main duties and responsibilities

•
Work closely with all members of the lab carrying out excellent research

•
Supervise students and collaborate with other postdocs

•
(optional) Contribute to teaching (especially if interested in an academic career)

Profile

•
Highly motivated with proven scientific excellence in the areas of vector query processing, serverless/just-in-time query execution, parallel and distributed data management, and data management systems on emerging hardware

•
Passionate about inventing, building, and publishing quality database systems research

•
A strong publication record and hands-on experience in system development are especially important

We offer

• The DIAS Lab team is renowned for its collaborative and nourishing culture, which supports the lab’s members since their first day in the team and long after their departure

•
Excellent working conditions

•
The contract is fixed for one year initially, renewable up to four years

Informations

Interested parties should send an application through the system including a CV, a research statement, and the names of at least three references. For inquiries regarding the research aspects of the position, contact Prof. Anastasia Ailamaki .

Contract Start Date : 01/01/2026

Activity Rate : 100.00

Contract Type : CDD

descriptionByLocale.en:
Mission

Despite recent technological advances both in the data management and in computer architecture domains, our ability to analyze data still falls behind the unstoppable data collection rates. Data-intensive applications are increasingly more demanding in sophisticated algorithms to store, manage, and interpret data. To meet the challenges, database software needs to communicate efficiently both with the application layer and with the underlying hardware platforms, and deliver seamless computational and data management support. Research in the DIAS lab addresses both aspects of the challenge: we adapt data management technology to computer architecture trends by designing data manipulation techniques that exploit optimally the underlying hardware and I/O devices, and we enable new discoveries in scientific domains through automating physical database design and revolutionizing exploration algorithms in very large data repositories. The DIAS lab pioneers just-in-time query engines which support analytics on raw data, data cleaning and query optimization for heterogeneous distributed data, and hardware/software codesigned engines for demanding applications.

Main duties and responsibilities

•
Work closely with all members of the lab carrying out excellent research

•
Supervise students and collaborate with other postdocs

•
(optional) Contribute to teaching (especially if interested in an academic career)

Profile

•
Highly motivated with proven scientific excellence in the areas of vector query processing, serverless/just-in-time query execution, parallel and distributed data management, and data management systems on emerging hardware

•
Passionate about inventing, building, and publishing quality database systems research

•
A strong publication record and hands-on experience in system development are especially important

We offer

• The DIAS Lab team is renowned for its collaborative and nourishing culture, which supports the lab’s members since their first day in the team and long after their departure

•
Excellent working conditions

•
The contract is fixed for one year initially, renewable up to four years

Informations

Interested parties should send an application through the system including a CV, a research statement, and the names of at least three references. For inquiries regarding the research aspects of the position, contact Prof. Anastasia Ailamaki .

Contract Start Date : 01/01/2026

Activity Rate : 100.00

Contract Type : CDD

Duration: 1-year fixed-term contract, renewable

Reference: 1809

jobs.description:
Mission

The Chair of Operations, Economics and Strategy (OES) at the College of Management of Technology at EPFL invites applications for a full-time PhD student position within the EPFL doctoral school program in Management of Technology (EDMT).

We are offering a challenging full-time PhD student position at the Chair of Operations, Economics and Strategy (OES) at EPFL.

The mission of OES is to conduct world-class research and teaching at the intersection of operations, economics, and strategy, with a focus on organizations and their interactions.

At OES, you will have the opportunity to work on the design, analysis, and implementation of innovative models for decision-making, economics, and operations. Research topics may include optimization, decision-making under uncertainty, market design and pricing, operations research, dynamic systems, and strategy-relevant applications.

Main duties and responsibilities

• Develop and complete an original doctoral dissertation

• Conduct independent research in close interaction with the Chair and, where appropriate, with external or industry partners

• Contribute to teaching activities, including co-supervision of student projects

• Provide limited support for academic and administrative activities of the Chair

Profile

• An excellent Master’s-level degree in Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Operations Research, Economics, Industrial Engineering, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field

• A strong mathematical background, including familiarity with optimization, probability, and the analysis of mathematical models

• A sincere interest in business-related, economic, and operational problems

• Proficiency in English

• Strong motivation for academic research, critical thinking, independence, good self-management skills, and team spirit

• Interest in a career involving research and teaching is an asset

We offer

• Excellent working conditions in an international research environment

• Individual and intensive supervision of your PhD project

• Financial support in accordance with EPFL doctoral student conditions

• The opportunity to work on rigorous, practically relevant research at the interface of operations, economics, and strategy

Informations

Your application should include:

• CV

• Motivation letter

• Diplomas

• Transcripts/grades from Bachelor’s and Master’s studies

To be eligible for a PhD at EPFL, candidates must be admitted to an EPFL doctoral school program. For this position, candidates should also apply to the EPFL EDMT Doctoral School :
https://www.epfl.ch/education/phd/edmt-management-of-technology/edmt-how-to-apply/

Application deadlines: January 15, 2027 and April 15, 2027. Applications to OES may be reviewed on a rolling basis; formal admission to EDMT requires a complete application by one of these deadlines.

Expected start date: September 1st, 2027. An alternative start date may exceptionally be agreed upon by mutual agreement.

Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

jobs.description:
About the Swiss Data Science Center (SDSC)

The Swiss Data Science Center (SDSC) is a national research infrastructure of the ETH domain in data science and artificial intelligence (AI), with EPFL and ETH Zurich as founding partners. Its mandate is to support academic labs, hospitals, industry and public sector stakeholders, including cantonal and federal administrations, through their entire data science journey, from the collection and management of data to machine learning, AI, and industrialization. With a large multidisciplinary team of professionals across three locations (Lausanne, Zurich, Villigen), the SDSC provides expertise and services across domains such as health and biomedical sciences, energy and sustainability, climate and environment, and large-scale scientific infrastructure.

The candidate will be integrated into a dynamic and rich environment, with people from different fields and expertise, and will be part of SDSC's Research team. The Research team at SDSC comprises more than 35 data scientists, seeking to apply novel AI/ML methods to solve real-world problems in the academic and public sectors. See https://datascience.ch/projects for an idea of some of our academic research collaborations.

Mission

As a Data Scientist working in the Research team of the Swiss Data Science Center, you will help researchers and other collaborators in academia or the public sector in Switzerland to leverage state-of-the-art Machine Learning and AI methods. descriptionByLocale.de: Über das Swiss Data Science Center (SDSC) Das Swiss Data Science Center (SDSC) ist eine nationale Forschungsinfrastruktur des ETH-Bereichs in den Bereichen Datenwissenschaft und künstliche Intelligenz (KI), mit der EPFL und der ETH Zürich als Gründungspartnern. Mit einem großen multidisziplinären Team von Fachleuten an drei Standorten (Lausanne, Zürich, Villigen) bietet das SDSC Fachwissen und Dienstleistungen in Bereichen wie Gesundheits- und Biomedizinwissenschaften, Energie und Nachhaltigkeit, Klima und Umwelt sowie groß angelegte wissenschaftliche Infrastruktur.
