jobs.description:
Mission

To support the Vice-President for Strategic Initiatives in developing and managing strategic partnerships that strengthen EPFL’s national and international standing.

Acting as a bridge between the academic world, the healthcare system, public authorities, charitable organisations and industry, you will help to establish collaborations with significant scientific and societal impact. You will act as a trusted partner and strategic advisor, identifying opportunities, analysing challenges and shaping decisions.

Working closely with the Vice-President and her Deputy, you will help steer a portfolio of initiatives and ensure alignment with the Vice-Presidency’s priorities. The role places particular emphasis on managing interfaces with partner organisations, developing ecosystems and multi-institutional collaborations.

Main duties and responsibilities

Strategic advice and partnership in strategic thinking

• Support the Vice-President as a sparring partner on strategic issues.

• Analyse complex situations and formulate concrete recommendations.

• Challenge assumptions and provide new perspectives.

Development and implementation of strategic initiatives

• Contribute to the design and implementation of multi-partner initiatives.

• Coordinate internal and external stakeholders.

• Structure governance, roadmaps and plans for implementation.

• Facilitate alignment between partners and contribute to resolving emerging challenges.

Executive support and institutional positioning

• Prepare briefings, analyses, presentations and speeches.

•
Carry out benchmarking, landscape analysis and strategic monitoring.

•
In collaboration with Institutional Affairs, contribute to EPFL’s positioning in national and international discussions on research, innovation and higher education.

Partnership coordination and representation

• Facilitate interactions with key external partners.

• Monitor strategic commitments and initiatives.

• Organise high-stakes meetings and interactions.

• Represent the Vice-President on an ad hoc basis.

• Develop trust-based relationships with stakeholders.

Profile

• Higher education; a PhD or equivalent experience is an asset.

• 5 years or more of experience in developing and managing strategic partnerships, complex multi-stakeholder initiatives or institutional collaborations.

• Experience in higher education, research, innovation, healthcare, consultancy, public affairs, philanthropy or a related field is an advantage.

• Proven ability to engage with high-level decision-makers in academic, public, hospital, philanthropic and industrial sectors.

• Good understanding of research, innovation and higher education ecosystems.

• Excellent analytical, synthesis and communication skills, with an ability to quickly grasp complex scientific and institutional issues.

• Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage several strategic projects simultaneously.

• High degree of autonomy, diplomacy, discretion and political acumen.

• Entrepreneurial spirit and the ability to identify opportunities and drive projects forward.

• Excellent command of French and English; German is an asset.

Why join the VPS and EPFL?

• Contribute to high-impact initiatives at the interface between science, innovation and society.

• Interact with leading national and international partners.

• Play a central role in developing EPFL’s strategic collaborations.

• Work directly with institutional decision-makers and high-level external stakeholders.

• Contribute to the development of ambitious initiatives with significant scientific and societal impact.

Informations

Activity Rate Min : 100,00

Activity Rate Max : 100,00

Contract Type: CDD

Duration: 1 an

Reference: 2303

descriptionByLocale.it: Missione Supportare il vicepresidente per le iniziative strategiche nello sviluppo e nella gestione di partenariati strategici che rafforzino la posizione nazionale e internazionale dell’EPFL. Agendo da ponte tra il mondo accademico, il sistema sanitario, le autorità pubbliche, le organizzazioni di beneficenza e l'industria, contribuirai a stabilire collaborazioni con un significativo impatto scientifico e sociale. Agirai come partner di fiducia e consulente strategico, identificando opportunità, analizzando le sfide e modellando le decisioni. Lavorando a stretto contatto con la Vicepresidente e il suo Vice, contribuirai a indirizzare un portafoglio di iniziative e a garantire l'allineamento con le priorità della Vicepresidenza. Il ruolo pone particolare enfasi sulla gestione delle interfacce con le organizzazioni partner, sullo sviluppo di ecosistemi e sulle collaborazioni multi-istituzionali. Principali mansioni e responsabilità Consulenza strategica e partnership nel pensiero strategico • Supportare il Vicepresidente come sparring partner su questioni strategiche. • Analizzare situazioni complesse e formulare raccomandazioni concrete. • Sfidare le ipotesi e fornire nuove prospettive. Sviluppo e implementazione di iniziative strategiche • Contribuire alla progettazione e implementazione di iniziative multi-partner. • Coordinare gli stakeholder interni ed esterni. • Governance della struttura, tabelle di marcia e piani di attuazione. • Facilitare l'allineamento tra i partner e contribuire a risolvere le sfide emergenti. Supporto esecutivo e posizionamento istituzionale • Preparare briefing, analisi, presentazioni e discorsi. • Effettuare benchmarking, analisi del paesaggio e monitoraggio strategico. • In collaborazione con gli Affari Istituzionali, contribuire al posizionamento dell'EPFL nei dibattiti nazionali e internazionali sulla ricerca, l'innovazione e l'istruzione superiore. Coordinamento e rappresentanza del partenariato • Facilitare le interazioni con i principali partner esterni. • Monitorare gli impegni e le iniziative strategiche. • Organizzare riunioni e interazioni ad alto rischio. • Rappresentare il Vicepresidente su base ad hoc. • Sviluppare relazioni basate sulla fiducia con le parti interessate. Profilo • Istruzione superiore; un dottorato di ricerca o un'esperienza equivalente è un vantaggio. • 5 anni o più di esperienza nello sviluppo e nella gestione di partnership strategiche, iniziative complesse multi-stakeholder o collaborazioni istituzionali. • L'esperienza nel campo dell'istruzione superiore, della ricerca, dell'innovazione, della sanità, della consulenza, degli affari pubblici, della filantropia o in un campo correlato costituisce un vantaggio. • Comprovata capacità di interagire con decisori di alto livello nei settori accademico, pubblico, ospedaliero, filantropico e industriale. • Buona conoscenza degli ecosistemi di ricerca, innovazione e istruzione superiore. • Ottime capacità analitiche, di sintesi e di comunicazione, con capacità di cogliere rapidamente questioni scientifiche e istituzionali complesse. • Forti capacità organizzative e capacità di gestire diversi progetti strategici contemporaneamente. • Elevato grado di autonomia, diplomazia, discrezione e acume politico. • Spirito imprenditoriale e capacità di identificare opportunità e portare avanti progetti. • Ottima padronanza del francese e dell'inglese; Il tedesco è una risorsa. Perché aderire al VPS e all'EPFL? • Contribuire a iniziative ad alto impatto nell'interfaccia tra scienza, innovazione e società. • Interagire con i principali partner nazionali e internazionali. • Svolgere un ruolo centrale nello sviluppo delle collaborazioni strategiche dell'EPFL. • Lavorare direttamente con i decisori istituzionali e le parti interessate esterne di alto livello. • Contribuire allo sviluppo di iniziative ambiziose con un significativo impatto scientifico e sociale. Informazioni Data Inizio Contratto: 01/09/2026 Tariffa attività Min: 100,00 Tariffa attività Max: 100,00 Tipologia contratto: CDD Durata: 1 an Riferimento: 2303

Entwicklung und Umsetzung strategischer Initiativen • Beitrag zur Gestaltung und Umsetzung von Initiativen mit mehreren Partnern. • Koordinieren Sie interne und externe Stakeholder. • Strukturieren Sie Governance, Roadmaps und Pläne für die Umsetzung. • Erleichtern Sie die Abstimmung zwischen Partnern und tragen Sie zur Lösung aufkommender Herausforderungen bei. Unterstützung der Führungskräfte und institutionelle Positionierung • Bereiten Sie Briefings, Analysen, Präsentationen und Reden vor. • Führen Sie Benchmarking, Landschaftsanalysen und strategische Überwachung durch. • Tragen Sie in Zusammenarbeit mit Institutional Affairs zur Positionierung der EPFL in nationalen und internationalen Diskussionen über Forschung, Innovation und Hochschulbildung bei. Partnerschaftskoordination und -vertretung • Erleichtern Sie die Interaktion mit wichtigen externen Partnern. • Überwachen Sie strategische Verpflichtungen und Initiativen. • Organisieren Sie wichtige Meetings und Interaktionen. • Vertretung des Vizepräsidenten auf Ad-hoc-Basis. • Aufbau vertrauensbasierter Beziehungen zu Stakeholdern. titleByLocale.it: Consigliere Strategico del Vicepresidente
titleByLocale.en: Strategic Advisor to the Vice-President
titleByLocale.fr: Conseiller·ère stratégique auprès de la Vice-présidence

jobs.description:
Mission

Soutenir la Vice-présidente pour le soutien aux Initiatives Stratégiques (VPS) dans le développement et la gestion de partenariats stratégiques qui renforcent le positionnement national et international de l’EPFL.

À l’interface entre le monde académique, le système de santé, les pouvoirs publics, la philanthropie et l’industrie, vous contribuez à structurer des collaborations à fort impact scientifique et sociétal. Vous agissez comme partenaire de confiance et de réflexion stratégique, en identifiant des opportunités, en analysant les enjeux et en structurant les décisions.

En collaboration étroite avec la Vice-présidente et son Adjoint, vous contribuez à piloter un portefeuille d’initiatives et à assurer la cohérence avec les priorités de la Vice-présidence. Le poste met un accent particulier sur la gestion des interfaces avec les organisations partenaires, le développement d’écosystèmes et les collaborations multi-institutionnelles.

Principales tâches et responsabilités

Conseil stratégique et partenariat de réflexion

• Accompagner la Vice-présidente comme sparring partner sur des enjeux stratégiques.

• Analyser des situations complexes et formuler des recommandations concrètes.

• Challenger les hypothèses et apporter des perspectives nouvelles.

Développement et déploiement d’initiatives stratégiques

• Contribuer à la conception et au déploiement d’initiatives multi-partenaires.

• Coordonner les parties prenantes internes et externes.

• Structurer gouvernance, feuilles de route et mise en œuvre.

• Faciliter l’alignement entre partenaires et contribuer à la résolution des défis émergents.

Appui exécutif et positionnement institutionnel

• Préparer briefings, analyses, présentations et discours.

• Réaliser des benchmarks et veilles stratégiques.

• En collaboration avec les Affaires Institutionnelles, contribuer au positionnement de l’EPFL dans les discussions nationales et internationales relatives à la recherche, l’innovation et l’enseignement supérieur.

Coordination des partenariats et représentation

• Faciliter les interactions avec les partenaires externes clés

• Assurer le suivi des engagements et des dossiers stratégiques

• Organiser réunions et interactions à fort enjeu

• Représenter ponctuellement la Vice-présence

• Développer des relations de confiance avec les parties prenantes

Profil

• Formation universitaire supérieure; doctorat ou expérience équivalente constitue un atout.

• 5 ans et plus d’expérience dans le développement et la gestion de partenariats stratégiques, d’initiatives complexes multi-acteurs ou de collaborations institutionnelles.

• Une expérience dans l’enseignement supérieur, la recherche, l’innovation, la santé, le conseil, les affaires publiques, la philanthropie ou un domaine connexe constitue un avantage.

• Capacité avérée à interagir avec des décideurs de haut niveau dans les milieux académique, public, hospitalier, philanthropique et industriel.

• Bonne compréhension des écosystèmes de la recherche, de l’innovation et de l’enseignement supérieur.

• Excellentes capacités d’analyse, de synthèse et de communication, avec une aptitude à appréhender rapidement des sujets scientifiques et institutionnels complexes.

• Solides compétences organisationnelles et capacité à gérer simultanément plusieurs dossiers stratégiques.

• Grande autonomie, diplomatie, discrétion et sens politique.

• Esprit entrepreneurial et capacité à identifier des opportunités et à faire avancer des projets.

• Excellente maîtrise du français et de l’anglais ; l’allemand constitue un atout.

Pourquoi rejoindre la VPS et l’EPFL ?

• Contribuer à des initiatives à fort impact à l’interface entre science, innovation et société.

• Interagir avec des partenaires nationaux et internationaux de premier plan.

• Jouer un rôle central dans le développement des collaborations stratégiques d’EPFL.

• Travailler directement avec des décideurs institutionnels et des acteurs externes de haut niveau

descriptionByLocale.it:
Missione Supportare il Vicepresidente per il sostegno alle iniziative strategiche (VPS) nello sviluppo e nella gestione di partenariati strategici che rafforzano il posizionamento nazionale e internazionale dell'EPFL. All'interfaccia tra mondo accademico, sistema sanitario, autorità pubbliche, filantropia e industria, contribuite a strutturare collaborazioni dal forte impatto scientifico e sociale. Agisci come un partner fidato e dal pensiero strategico, identificando opportunità, analizzando problemi e strutturando le decisioni. In stretta collaborazione con la Vicepresidente e il suo Vice, contribuisci a gestire un portafoglio di iniziative e garantisci la coerenza con le priorità della Vicepresidenza. La posizione pone particolare enfasi sulla gestione delle interfacce con le organizzazioni partner, sullo sviluppo dell'ecosistema e sulle collaborazioni multi-istituzionali. Principali compiti e responsabilità Consulenza strategica e partenariato di riflessione
• Supportare il Vicepresidente come sparring partner su questioni strategiche.
• Analizzare situazioni complesse e formulare raccomandazioni concrete.
• Sfidare le ipotesi e fornire nuove prospettive. Sviluppo e realizzazione di iniziative strategiche
• Contribuire alla progettazione e realizzazione di iniziative multi-partner.
• Coordinare gli stakeholder interni ed esterni.
• Governance della struttura, tabelle di marcia e attuazione.
• Facilitare l'allineamento tra i partner e contribuire alla risoluzione delle sfide emergenti. Supporto esecutivo e posizionamento istituzionale
• Preparare briefing, analisi, presentazioni e discorsi.
• Effettuare benchmark e monitoraggio strategico.
• In collaborazione con gli Affari Istituzionali, contribuire al posizionamento dell'EPFL nei dibattiti nazionali e internazionali relativi alla ricerca, all'innovazione e all'istruzione superiore. Coordinamento di partenariati e rappresentanza
• Facilitare le interazioni con i principali partner esterni
• Garantire il seguito degli impegni e dei file strategici
• Organizzare riunioni e interazioni ad alto rischio
• Rappresentare la Vice-presenza su base ad hoc
• Sviluppare rapporti di fiducia con le parti interessate Profilo
• Istruzione universitaria superiore; Il dottorato o un'esperienza equivalente costituiscono un vantaggio.
• 5 anni o più di esperienza nello sviluppo e nella gestione di partnership strategiche, iniziative complesse multi-stakeholder o collaborazioni istituzionali.
• L'esperienza nel campo dell'istruzione superiore, della ricerca, dell'innovazione, della sanità, della consulenza, degli affari pubblici, della filantropia o in un campo correlato costituisce un vantaggio.
• Comprovata capacità di interagire con decisori di alto livello in contesti accademici, pubblici, ospedalieri, filantropici e industriali.
• Buona conoscenza degli ecosistemi di ricerca, innovazione e istruzione superiore.
• Ottime capacità analitiche, di sintesi e di comunicazione, con capacità di cogliere rapidamente argomenti scientifici e istituzionali complessi.
• Forti capacità organizzative e capacità di gestire più file strategici contemporaneamente.
• Grande autonomia, diplomazia, discrezione e senso politico.
• Spirito imprenditoriale e capacità di identificare opportunità e portare avanti progetti.
• Ottima padronanza del francese e dell'inglese; Il tedesco è una risorsa. Perché aderire a VPS ed EPFL?
• Contribuire a iniziative ad alto impatto nell'interfaccia tra scienza, innovazione e società.
• Interagire con i principali partner nazionali e internazionali.
• Svolgere un ruolo centrale nello sviluppo delle collaborazioni strategiche dell'EPFL.
• Lavorare direttamente con i decisori istituzionali e le parti interessate esterne di alto livello
descriptionByLocale.en:
Mission Support the Vice-President for Support for Strategic Initiatives (VPS) in the development and management of strategic partnerships that strengthen the national and international positioning of EPFL. At the interface between the academic world, the health system, public authorities, philanthropy and industry, you contribute to structuring collaborations with strong scientific and societal impact. You act as a trusted and strategic thinking partner, identifying opportunities, analyzing issues and structuring decisions. In close collaboration with the Vice-President and her Deputy, you help to manage a portfolio of initiatives and ensure consistency with the priorities of the Vice-Presidency. The position places particular emphasis on managing interfaces with partner organizations, ecosystem development and multi-institutional collaborations. Main tasks and responsibilities Strategic advice and reflection partnership
• Support the Vice-President as a sparring partner on strategic issues.
• Analyze complex situations and formulate concrete recommendations.
• Challenge assumptions and provide new perspectives. Development and deployment of strategic initiatives
• Contribute to the design and deployment of multi-partner initiatives.
• Coordinate internal and external stakeholders.
• Structure governance, roadmaps and implementation.
• Facilitate alignment between partners and contribute to the resolution of emerging challenges. Executive support and institutional positioning
• Prepare briefings, analyses, presentations and speeches.
• Carry out benchmarks and strategic monitoring.
• In collaboration with Institutional Affairs, contribute to the positioning of EPFL in national and international discussions relating to research, innovation and higher education. Coordination of partnerships and representation
• Facilitate interactions with key external partners
• Ensure follow-up on commitments and strategic files
• Organize high-stakes meetings and interactions
• Represent the Vice-presence on an ad hoc basis
• Develop relationships of trust with stakeholders Profile
• Higher university education; PhD or equivalent experience is an asset.
• 5 years or more of experience in developing and managing strategic partnerships, complex multi-stakeholder initiatives or institutional collaborations.
• Experience in higher education, research, innovation, healthcare, consulting, public affairs, philanthropy or a related field is an advantage.
• Proven ability to interact with high-level decision-makers in academic, public, hospital, philanthropic and industrial settings.
• Good understanding of the research, innovation and higher education ecosystems.
• Excellent analytical, synthesis and communication skills, with an ability to quickly grasp complex scientific and institutional subjects.
• Strong organizational skills and ability to manage several strategic files simultaneously.
• Great autonomy, diplomacy, discretion and political sense.
• Entrepreneurial spirit and ability to identify opportunities and advance projects.
• Excellent command of French and English; German is an asset. Why join VPS and EPFL?
• Contribute to high-impact initiatives at the interface between science, innovation and society.
• Interact with leading national and international partners.
• Play a central role in the development of EPFL’s strategic collaborations.
• Work directly with institutional decision-makers and high-level external stakeholders
descriptionByLocale.de:
Mission Unterstützen Sie den Vizepräsidenten für die Unterstützung strategischer Initiativen (VPS) bei der Entwicklung und Verwaltung strategischer Partnerschaften, die die nationale und internationale Positionierung der EPFL stärken. An der Schnittstelle zwischen Wissenschaft, Gesundheitssystem, Behörden, Philanthropie und Industrie tragen Sie zur Gestaltung von Kooperationen mit starker wissenschaftlicher und gesellschaftlicher Wirkung bei. Sie agieren als vertrauenswürdiger und strategisch denkender Partner, der Chancen erkennt, Probleme analysiert und Entscheidungen strukturiert. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit der Vizepräsidentin und ihrem Stellvertreter helfen Sie bei der Verwaltung eines Portfolios von Initiativen und stellen die Übereinstimmung mit den Prioritäten der Vizepräsidentschaft sicher. Die Position legt besonderen Wert auf die Verwaltung von Schnittstellen zu Partnerorganisationen, die Entwicklung von Ökosystemen und multiinstitutionelle Kooperationen. Hauptaufgaben und Verantwortungsbereiche Strategische Beratung und Reflexionspartnerschaft
• Unterstützung des Vizepräsidenten als Sparringspartner in strategischen Fragen.
• Analysieren Sie komplexe Situationen und formulieren Sie konkrete Empfehlungen.
• Hinterfragen Sie Annahmen und bieten Sie neue Perspektiven. Entwicklung und Umsetzung strategischer Initiativen
• Beitrag zur Gestaltung und Umsetzung von Initiativen mit mehreren Partnern.
• Koordinieren Sie interne und externe Stakeholder.
• Strukturieren Sie Governance, Roadmaps und Implementierung.
• Erleichterung der Abstimmung zwischen Partnern und Beitrag zur Lösung neu auftretender Herausforderungen. Unterstützung der Führungskräfte und institutionelle Positionierung
• Bereiten Sie Briefings, Analysen, Präsentationen und Reden vor.
• Durchführung von Benchmarks und strategischem Monitoring.
• Tragen Sie in Zusammenarbeit mit Institutional Affairs zur Positionierung der EPFL in nationalen und internationalen Diskussionen über Forschung, Innovation und Hochschulbildung bei. Koordinierung von Partnerschaften und Vertretung
• Erleichtern Sie die Interaktion mit wichtigen externen Partnern.
• Sorgen Sie für die Nachverfolgung von Verpflichtungen und strategischen Dossiers.
• Organisieren Sie wichtige Besprechungen und Interaktionen. Ein Doktortitel oder gleichwertige Erfahrung ist von Vorteil.
• 5 Jahre oder mehr Erfahrung in der Entwicklung und Verwaltung strategischer Partnerschaften, komplexer Multi-Stakeholder-Initiativen oder institutioneller Kooperationen.
• Erfahrung in den Bereichen Hochschulbildung, Forschung, Innovation, Gesundheitswesen, Beratung, öffentliche Angelegenheiten, Philanthropie oder einem verwandten Bereich ist von Vorteil.
• Nachgewiesene Fähigkeit zur Interaktion mit hochrangigen Entscheidungsträgern im akademischen, öffentlichen, Krankenhaus-, philanthropischen und industriellen Umfeld.
• Gutes Verständnis der Forschungs-, Innovations- und Hochschulökosysteme.
• Hervorragende Analyse-, Synthese- und Kommunikationsfähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, komplexe wissenschaftliche und institutionelle Themen schnell zu erfassen.
• Starke organisatorische Fähigkeiten und die Fähigkeit, mehrere strategische Dateien gleichzeitig zu verwalten.
• Große Autonomie, Diplomatie, Diskretion und politisches Gespür.
• Unternehmergeist und die Fähigkeit, Chancen zu erkennen und Projekte voranzutreiben.
• Ausgezeichnete Französisch- und Englischkenntnisse; Deutsch ist von Vorteil. Warum VPS und EPFL beitreten?
• Tragen Sie zu wirkungsvollen Initiativen an der Schnittstelle zwischen Wissenschaft, Innovation und Gesellschaft bei.
• Interagieren Sie mit führenden nationalen und internationalen Partnern.
• Eine zentrale Rolle bei der Entwicklung der strategischen Kooperationen der EPFL spielen.
• Arbeiten Sie direkt mit institutionellen Entscheidungsträgern und hochrangigen externen Stakeholdern zusammen

jobs.title: Industry Liaison Officer

titleByLocale.it: Industry Liaison Officer
titleByLocale.en: Industrial Liaison Officer
titleByLocale.fr: Agent de liaison avec l'industrie

jobs.description:
Description

The Industry Liaison Officer develops, supports and nurtures a trustful relationship between EPFL's industrial partners and EPFL ecosystem. You will be responsible for establishing and maintaining long-term relationship between industrial accounts and EPFL. You will be able to identify needs and requirements to develop industry – academia collaboration. You will be the privileged point of contact for all kinds of collaboration models. You will work with other EPFL services and entities to promote EPFL's research competencies and innovation capabilities.

Mission

In this position, you will be part of the Industrial Liaison Office and work closely with all the units of the Vice-Presidency for Innovation and Impact (VPI), developing a solid knowledge of the EPFL Innovation ecosystem, including research laboratories, students and startups, to become a privileged point of contact for a portfolio of companies and a trusted point of contact for researchers. In addition, you will contribute to the design, delivery, and continuous improvement of EPFL Open Innovation Program, creating value for participating companies while strengthening long-term engagement with EPFL.

Main duties and responsibilities

• Foster trustful relationship with a portfolio of companies having a long-term relationship with EPFL.

• Build relationships with new industry partners.

• Actively contribute to the design, delivery and continuous improvement of our Open Innovation Program, ensuring a high-value experience for participating companies and alignment with institutional objectives.

• Acquire a thorough understanding of companies and professors' needs and ensure appropriate collaboration models and services are developed and delivered. Link to other EPFL entities depending on the needs.

• Acquire a strong knowledge and understanding of EPFL ecosystem for helping companies to identify the right partners for their innovation projects

• Be proactive in proposing new potential collaboration opportunities by following EPFL research activities.

• Resolve any issues and problems the partner faces and deal with complaints to maintain trust and enrich existing collaboration.

• Serve as the communication link between companies, researchers, EPFL & VPI teams and services.

• Represent the VPI and organize industrial visits.

• Prepare regular reports of progress and forecasts using key account metrics.

Other activities

• Support the different VPI and EPFL industry support programs and contribute developing new services for VPI and EPFL.

Profile

• Scientific or engineering background (Master degree, Ph.D. a plus), with a specialization in Life Sciences.

• Passion for science and technology-driven innovation

• Three to five years of relevant experience and/or training or equivalent combination.

• Former experience in product development and/or innovation management in a technology company.

• Experience in providing solutions based on customer needs.

• Strong communication and interpersonal skills with aptitude in building relationships with professionals of all organization levels and different cultures.

• Excellent organizational skills and ability in problem-solving and negotiation.

• Excellent presentation skills.

• Languages: Fluency in English and French is required, and other languages (e.g., German/) would be a plus.

• Team player, autonomous, curious with a strong commitment to results.

We offer

• Collaborative and innovative work environment.

• Access to a diverse and dynamic community of researchers, entrepreneurs and industry experts.

• A stimulating and friendly work atmosphere with excellent working conditions.

• An inclusive workspace and equal opportunities for all.

Remark

Only candidates who applied through EPFL website or our partner Jobup’s website will be considered. Files sent by agencies without a mandate will not be taken into account.

Informations

Contract Start Date : 09/01/2026

Activity Rate M

descriptionByLocale.it: Descrizione L'Industry Liaison Officer sviluppa, sostiene e coltiva un rapporto di fiducia tra i partner industriali dell'EPFL e l'ecosistema EPFL. Sarai responsabile di stabilire e mantenere una relazione a lungo termine tra i conti industriali e l'EPFL. Sarai in grado di identificare esigenze e requisiti per sviluppare la collaborazione tra industria e mondo accademico. Sarai il punto di contatto privilegiato per tutti i tipi di modelli di collaborazione. Lavorerai con altri servizi ed entità dell'EPFL per promuovere le competenze di ricerca e le capacità di innovazione dell'EPFL. Missione In questa posizione, farai parte dell'Industrial Liaison Office e lavorerai a stretto contatto con tutte le unità della Vicepresidenza per l'Innovazione e l'Impatto (VPI), sviluppando una solida conoscenza dell'ecosistema dell'innovazione dell'EPFL, compresi laboratori di ricerca, studenti e startup, per diventare un punto di contatto privilegiato per un portafoglio di aziende e un punto di contatto fidato per i ricercatori. Inoltre, contribuirai alla progettazione, realizzazione e miglioramento continuo del programma EPFL Open Innovation, creando valore per le aziende partecipanti e rafforzando al tempo stesso l'impegno a lungo termine con l'EPFL. Offriamo • Ambiente di lavoro collaborativo e innovativo. • Accesso a una comunità diversificata e dinamica di ricercatori, imprenditori ed esperti del settore. • Un'atmosfera di lavoro stimolante e amichevole con eccellenti condizioni di lavoro. • Uno spazio di lavoro inclusivo e pari opportunità per tutti. descriptionByLocale.en:
Description

The Industry Liaison Officer develops, supports and nurtures a trustful relationship between EPFL's industrial partners and EPFL ecosystem. You will be responsible for establishing and maintaining long-term relationship between industrial accounts and EPFL. You will be able to identify needs and requirements to develop industry – academia collaboration. You will be the privileged point of contact for all kinds of collaboration models. You will work with other EPFL services and entities to promote EPFL's research competencies and innovation capabilities.

Mission

In this position, you will be part of the Industrial Liaison Office and work closely with all the units of the Vice-Presidency for Innovation and Impact (VPI), developing a solid knowledge of the EPFL Innovation ecosystem, including research laboratories, students and startups, to become a privileged point of contact for a portfolio of companies and a trusted point of contact for researchers. In addition, you will contribute to the design, delivery, and continuous improvement of EPFL Open Innovation Program, creating value for participating companies while strengthening long-term engagement with EPFL.

Main duties and responsibilities

• Foster trustful relationship with a portfolio of companies having a long-term relationship with EPFL.

• Build relationships with new industry partners.

• Actively contribute to the design, delivery and continuous improvement of our Open Innovation Program, ensuring a high-value experience for participating companies and alignment with institutional objectives.

• Acquire a thorough understanding of companies and professors' needs and ensure appropriate collaboration models and services are developed and delivered. Link to other EPFL entities depending on the needs.

• Acquire a strong knowledge and understanding of EPFL ecosystem for helping companies to identify the right partners for their innovation projects

• Be proactive in proposing new potential collaboration opportunities by following EPFL research activities.

• Resolve any issues and problems the partner faces and deal with complaints to maintain trust and enrich existing collaboration.

• Serve as the communication link between companies, researchers, EPFL & VPI teams and services.

• Represent the VPI and organize industrial visits.

• Prepare regular reports of progress and forecasts using key account metrics.

Other activities

• Support the different VPI and EPFL industry support programs and contribute developing new services for VPI and EPFL.

Profile

• Scientific or engineering background (Master degree, Ph.D. a plus), with a specialization in Life Sciences.

• Passion for science and technology-driven innovation

• Three to five years of relevant experience and/or training or equivalent combination.

• Former experience in product development and/or innovation management in a technology company.

• Experience in providing solutions based on customer needs.

• Strong communication and interpersonal skills with aptitude in building relationships with professionals of all organization levels and different cultures.

• Excellent organizational skills and ability in problem-solving and negotiation.

• Excellent presentation skills.

• Languages: Fluency in English and French is required, and other languages (e.g., German/) would be a plus.

• Team player, autonomous, curious with a strong commitment to results.

We offer

• Collaborative and innovative work environment.

• Access to a diverse and dynamic community of researchers, entrepreneurs and industry experts.

• A stimulating and friendly work atmosphere with excellent working conditions.

• An inclusive workspace and equal opportunities for all.

Remark

Only candidates who applied through EPFL website or our partner Jobup’s website will be considered. Files sent by agencies without a mandate will not be taken into account.

Informations

Activity Rate M

jobs.description:
Mission

We are offering two challenging positions as a full-time (100%) PhD Student at ENAC at EPFL, Lausanne, Switzerland. Our Laboratory EESD is focused on investigating the seismic behavior of reinforced concrete and unreinforced masonry buildings. Our approaches include numerical and mechanical modeling, large-scale testing as well as data-driven methods. The PhD candidates will contribute to advancing the understanding of the seismic behavior of historic brick masonry building aggregates through a combination of large-scale experimental testing, field investigations, and numerical simulations. The research will focus on the behavior and interaction of buildings within masonry aggregates, supporting the development of innovative assessment approaches and resilient retrofit solutions for historic urban environments exposed to earthquake risk.

You will be working on the ZAGGREGATE project, a collaborative research initiative between EPFL, University of Zagreb, and other academic and professional partners. The project aims to improve the understanding, assessment and rehabilitation of historic masonry building aggregates in seismic regions. The successful candidates will join a team of researchers working at the interface of structural engineering, earthquake engineering, and heritage conservation, and will have opportunities for collaboration and research visits in Croatia.

Main duties and responsibilities

As a PhD student you will be expected to:

• Conduct original doctoral research using experimental, numerical, and analytical methods to investigate the seismic response of masonry buildings as stand-alone buildings and within aggregates

• Contribute to the development of innovative assessment methodologies and resilient retrofit strategies for historic urban environments exposed to earthquake hazard

• Collaborating with project partners at EPFL, the University of Zagreb, and other international institutions

• Disseminating research findings through scientific publications and conference presentations

• Have full responsibility for your own dissertation

• Participating in education and co-supervise student projects

Profile

• A MSc degree (or equivalent) in Civil Engineering with a focus on Structural Engineering

• Experience or strong interest in experimental and/or numerical methods in structural engineering

• Interest in traditional construction techniques and interdisciplinary collaboration (engineering, heritage, architecture)

• Self-motivated, independent, and collaborative mindset with a high level of rigor for academic research work

• Excellent communication skills in English (written and spoken) and willingness to work as part of a team

• Familiarity with Python, MATLAB or similar for data analysis

• Familiarity with numerical modeling tools (e.g. OpenSees, Abaqus, DIANA) is an asset

We offer

• A stimulating and international working environment

• Competitive salary and excellent working conditions, 1-year fixed-term contract (CDD), renewable for 3 years (4 years in total) to complete your PhD; more information can be found on our website

• You will be part of the EDCE doctoral program

• Opportunity to perform state-of-the-art research in one of the most dynamic scientific institutions in Europe

• Opportunity to interact with internationally renowned experts, and with a strong team of postdoctoral researchers and PhD students

• Opportunity to conduct meaningful research bridging engineering, cultural heritage, and development

Informations

The selection process involves multiple stages, and short-listed candidates will be requested to apply to a specific EPFL Doctoral Program to qualify for a PhD at EPFL, i.e. Doctoral School of Civil and Environmental Engineering (EDCE) .
Please check this page for additional information on admission.

Please note that this is a separate application process necessary to be eligible to complete your PhD at EPFL.

Missione Offriamo due posizioni stimolanti come dottorando a tempo pieno (100%) presso l'ENAC presso l'EPFL, Losanna, Svizzera. Il nostro Laboratorio EESD è focalizzato sullo studio del comportamento sismico degli edifici in cemento armato e muratura non armata. I nostri approcci includono modellazione numerica e meccanica, test su larga scala e metodi basati sui dati. I dottorandi contribuiranno a migliorare la comprensione del comportamento sismico degli aggregati edilizi storici in muratura attraverso una combinazione di prove sperimentali su larga scala, indagini sul campo e simulazioni numeriche. La ricerca si concentrerà sul comportamento e sull’interazione degli edifici all’interno degli aggregati di muratura, supportando lo sviluppo di approcci di valutazione innovativi e soluzioni di retrofit resilienti per ambienti urbani storici esposti al rischio sismico. Lavorerai al progetto ZAGGREGATE, un'iniziativa di ricerca collaborativa tra EPFL, Università di Zagabria e altri partner accademici e professionali. Il progetto mira a migliorare la comprensione, la valutazione e la riabilitazione degli aggregati edilizi in muratura storica nelle regioni sismiche. I candidati prescelti entreranno a far parte di un team di ricercatori che lavorano all'interfaccia tra ingegneria strutturale, ingegneria sismica e conservazione del patrimonio e avranno opportunità di collaborazione e visite di ricerca in Croazia. Principali compiti e responsabilità Come dottorando dovrai:
• Condurre ricerche di dottorato originali utilizzando metodi sperimentali, numerici e analitici per studiare la risposta sismica degli edifici in muratura come edifici autonomi e all'interno di aggregati
• Contribuire allo sviluppo di metodologie di valutazione innovative e strategie di retrofit resilienti per ambienti urbani storici esposti al rischio di terremoto
• Collaborare con i partner di progetto presso l'EPFL, l'Università di Zagabria e altre istituzioni internazionali
• Divulgare i risultati della ricerca attraverso pubblicazioni scientifiche e presentazioni a conferenze
• Avere pieno responsabilità per la propria tesi
• Partecipare alla formazione e co-supervisionare progetti degli studenti Profilo
• Una laurea magistrale (o equivalente) in ingegneria civile con particolare attenzione all'ingegneria strutturale
• Esperienza o forte interesse per metodi sperimentali e/o numerici nell'ingegneria strutturale
• Interesse per le tecniche di costruzione tradizionali e la collaborazione interdisciplinare (ingegneria, patrimonio, architettura)
• Mentalità automotivata, indipendente e collaborativa con un alto livello di rigore per il lavoro di ricerca accademica
• Eccellenti capacità di comunicazione in inglese (scritto e parlato) e disponibilità a lavorare come parte di un team
• Familiarità con Python, MATLAB o simili per l'analisi dei dati
• Familiarità con strumenti di modellazione numerica (es. OpenSees, Abaqus, DIANA) è una risorsa. Offriamo
• Un ambiente di lavoro stimolante e internazionale
• Stipendio competitivo e condizioni di lavoro eccellenti, contratto a tempo determinato (CDD) di 1 anno, rinnovabile per 3 anni (4 anni in totale) per completare il tuo dottorato di ricerca; maggiori informazioni possono essere trovate sul nostro sito web
• Farai parte del programma di dottorato EDCE
• Opportunità di svolgere ricerche all'avanguardia in una delle istituzioni scientifiche più dinamiche in Europa
• Opportunità di interagire con esperti di fama internazionale e con un forte team di ricercatori post-dottorato e dottorandi
• Opportunità di condurre ricerche significative che uniscano ingegneria, patrimonio culturale e sviluppo Informazioni Il processo di selezione prevede più fasi e ai candidati selezionati verrà richiesto di candidarsi per uno specifico dottorato EPFL Programma per qualificarsi per un dottorato di ricerca presso l'EPFL, ovvero la Scuola di Dottorato in Ingegneria Civile e Ambientale (EDCE). Si prega di controllare questa pagina per ulteriori informazioni sull'ammissione. Mission Wir bieten zwei herausfordernde Stellen als Vollzeit-Doktorand (100 %) am ENAC der EPFL, Lausanne, Schweiz, an. Unser Labor EESD konzentriert sich auf die Untersuchung des seismischen Verhaltens von Gebäuden aus Stahlbeton und unbewehrtem Mauerwerk. Unsere Ansätze umfassen numerische und mechanische Modellierung, groß angelegte Tests sowie datengesteuerte Methoden. Die Doktoranden werden durch eine Kombination aus groß angelegten experimentellen Tests, Felduntersuchungen und numerischen Simulationen dazu beitragen, das Verständnis des seismischen Verhaltens historischer Gebäudeaggregate aus Ziegelmauerwerk zu verbessern. Die Forschung wird sich auf das Verhalten und die Interaktion von Gebäuden innerhalb von Mauerwerksaggregaten konzentrieren und die Entwicklung innovativer Bewertungsansätze und widerstandsfähiger Sanierungslösungen für historische städtische Umgebungen unterstützen, die einem Erdbebenrisiko ausgesetzt sind. Sie werden am ZAGGREGATE-Projekt arbeiten, einer gemeinsamen Forschungsinitiative zwischen der EPFL, der Universität Zagreb und anderen akademischen und professionellen Partnern. Das Projekt zielt darauf ab, das Verständnis, die Bewertung und die Sanierung historischer Mauerwerksaggregate in seismischen Regionen zu verbessern. Die erfolgreichen Kandidaten werden Teil eines Forscherteams, das an der Schnittstelle von Bauingenieurwesen, Erdbebeningenieurwesen und Denkmalschutz arbeitet, und haben die Möglichkeit zur Zusammenarbeit und zu Forschungsaufenthalten in Kroatien. • Durchführung origineller Doktorarbeiten mit experimentellen, numerischen und analytischen Methoden zur Untersuchung der seismischen Reaktion von Mauerwerksgebäuden als eigenständige Gebäude und innerhalb von Aggregaten

Notre laboratoire EESD se concentre sur l'étude du comportement sismique des bâtiments en béton armé et en maçonnerie non armée. jobs.description:
Mission

We are offering a full-time (100%) PhD Student at the Laboratory for the Chemistry of Materials and Manufacturing (ALCHEMY) at EPFL Neuchatel. At EPFL ALCHEMY, we are focused on developing accessible chemistries and processing strategies that can enable the fabrication of a wide variety of advanced functional materials and devices.

A core area of research in ALCHEMY is the development of methods for converting 3D printed polymers into metals. We previously pioneered a technology called Hydrogel Infusion Additive Manufacturing (HIAM) that is capable of transforming polymers into composites, ceramics, and metals (Composites: https://doi.org/10.1016/j.matt.2026.102809 , https://doi.org/10.1021/acsmaterialslett.5c00407 ;Ceramics/Metals: https://doi.org/10.1002/adma.202504951 ).

The goal of this PhD will be to expand the HIAM technology towards new classes of materials. Depending on the candidate, this could include non-oxide ceramics, metal-matrix composites, ceramic-matrix composites, polymer composites, or high entropy alloys. The PhD will span the development of chemistries and processes that result in high quality architected ceramic/metal parts, and the applications of these materials.

Main duties and responsibilities

As a PhD Student, you will be expected to:

• Have full responsibility for your own dissertation

• Research in close collaboration with other lab members and international collaborators;

• Experiment design and execution

• Analyze and interpret experimental results

• Write scientific articles for publication in peer-reviewed journals

• Present at international conferences

• Participate in education and supervise student projects

Profile

• A MSc degree in the fields of materials science, chemistry, or polymer science

• Strong experimental skills and a practical and hands-on mindset

• Experience with materials characterization is required

• Excellent comunication skills in English

• Experience with ceramic and/or metal characterization is a bonus

• Experience with nanoparticle synthesis is a bonus

We offer

• 4 years to complete your PhD with a competitive remuneration

• You will be part of the EDMX, EDAM, or EDCH doctoral program

• An opportunity to develop a scientific career in materials science and additive manufacturing

• A world-class research and training environment with access to state-of-the-art research facilities

• International collaboration and visiting opportunities

• A 1-year fixed-term contract (CDD), renewable for 4 years

Informations

Only applications submitted through the online platform are considered . Please apply by uploading a single PDF file that contains the following:

• Cover/Motivation Letter that detail your past research experiences and your fit for the position

• Detailed CV

• Names and contact information of at least 2 references willing to write recommendation letters for you

The selection process involves multiple stages, and short-listed candidates will be requested to apply to a specific EPFL Doctoral Program to qualify for a PhD at EPFL, i.e. [EDMX, EDAM, or EDCH.
Please check this page for additional information on admission.

Please note that this is a separate application process necessary to be eligible to complete your PhD at EPFL.

Contract Start Date: 10/01/2026

Activity Rate : 100.00

Contract Type: CDD

Duration: 1 year, renewable for 4 years

Reference: 2307

For more information, please contact: daryl.yee@epfl.ch

Missione Offriamo uno studente di dottorato a tempo pieno (100%) presso il Laboratorio di Chimica dei Materiali e della Produzione (ALCHEMY) presso l'EPFL di Neuchâtel. Presso EPFL ALCHEMY ci concentriamo sullo sviluppo di sostanze chimiche accessibili e strategie di lavorazione che possano consentire la fabbricazione di un'ampia varietà di materiali e dispositivi funzionali avanzati. Un’area centrale di ricerca in ALCHEMY è lo sviluppo di metodi per convertire i polimeri stampati in 3D in metalli. In precedenza abbiamo sperimentato una tecnologia chiamata Hydrogel Infusion Additive Manufacturing (HIAM) in grado di trasformare i polimeri in compositi, ceramiche e metalli (Composites: https://doi.org/10.1016/j.matt.2026.102809, https://doi.org/10.1021/acsmaterialslett.5c00407; Ceramics/Metals: https://doi.org/10.1002/adma.202504951 ). L'obiettivo di questo dottorato sarà quello di espandere la tecnologia HIAM verso nuove classi di materiali. A seconda del candidato, ciò potrebbe includere ceramiche non contenenti ossidi, compositi a matrice metallica, compositi a matrice ceramica, compositi polimerici o leghe ad alta entropia. Il dottorato riguarderà lo sviluppo di prodotti chimici e processi che si traducono in parti architettoniche in ceramica/metallo di alta qualità e le applicazioni di questi materiali. jobs.description:
Mission

The EPFL Al Center focuses on advancing research, education and innovation in Al at EPFL and beyond. It is at the core of a vibrant EPFL community and dynamic external ecosystem that includes a large number of partners and stakeholders in Al, including academia, industry, government, and international organisations.

We are searching for a Regulatory Data Manager for National Initiatives in AI for Health

The role will support important research initiatives led by the EPFL AI Center, and the Swiss Data Science Center (SDSC). In particular, the new Regulatory Data Manager will be mainly involved in the National AI Initiative for Precision Oncology (NAIPO), which transforms cancer care in Switzerland by integrating advanced AI across the patient journey. It unites hospitals, companies, and startups to drive innovation, reduce healthcare costs, and position Switzerland as a leader in personalised medicine. NAIPO is led by the EPFL AI Center and comprises 31 partners such as universities, cantonal and private hospitals, national research infrastructure such as SDSC and CSCS, universities, private companies such as pharmaceutical companies or start-ups. That main mission will be complemented by an additional role in supporting translational initiatives led by the SDSC.

Please note that only applications meeting the criteria of the advertisement will be considered.

Main duties and responsibilities

You will collaborate with the EPFL AI Center, the SDSC and its clinical partners, the NAIPO Management Support Team, the legal department/office of each partner, the clinical coordinators and the NAIPO members.

In the context of NAIPO, you will

• Coordinate a comprehensive Data Protection Impact Assessment (DPIA) with research, hospital, and legal partners, evaluating privacy risks and mitigation strategies for each subproject.

• Coordinate the drafting of Clinical Study Protocols according to the Swiss Human Research Act and standardized Patient Information and Consent Forms (PICFs).

• Develop a modular Data Privacy Compliance Framework.

• Develop a standard Data Processing and Transfer Agreements (DPAs, DTAs).

• Define an AI model validation guidelines aligned with Swissmedic standards and ISO norms for medical software, ensuring the clinical deployment of AI tools meets regulatory expectations.

• Coordinate with the different legal department / office of each institution.

• Define, maintain and oversee the data management of NAIPO, in close collaboration with the data managers from SDSC and the implementation partners.

• Develop and implement a Regulatory Monitoring Plan to track changes to data protection, AI, and clinical research regulations over the project's lifetime, ensuring adaptive compliance. Promoting the EPFL AI Center, managing our extensive partner network, and building our ecosystem in Switzerland and beyond.

Furthermore, in the context of SDSC translational AI for health research projects, you will

• Support the writing of Data Processing and Transfer and Usage Agreements (DPAs, DTUAs) for Health & Biomedical projects.

• Support to organizations – particularly Swiss SMEs - in the path to SAMD : advise them regarding which types of projects and products explicitly require to undergo the process, and which ones make it highly recommended; advise them on the process and milestones linked to the different SAMD levels.

Profile

• More than five years of professional experience in a clinical regulatory environment and in writing clinical protocols

• Demonstrated expertise of the Swiss regulatory landscape and ethics committees (Swiss Human Research Act, data protection regulations…)

• Experience in negotiating with ethics committees

• Proven ability to translate regulatory requirements into practical operational frameworks for complex, multi-partner projects

• Ability to integrate in highly dynamic environments

• Capabilities for managing several projects at once and meeting deadlines

• Excel

descriptionByLocale.it:
Missione Il Centro Al dell'EPFL si concentra sul progresso della ricerca, dell'istruzione e dell'innovazione nel campo dell'Al all'EPFL e oltre. È al centro di una vivace comunità EPFL e di un dinamico ecosistema esterno che comprende un gran numero di partner e parti interessate in Al, tra cui il mondo accademico, l'industria, il governo e le organizzazioni internazionali. Stiamo cercando un responsabile dei dati normativi per le iniziative nazionali in AI for Health. Il ruolo supporterà importanti iniziative di ricerca guidate dall'EPFL AI Center e dallo Swiss Data Science Center (SDSC). In particolare, il nuovo Regulatory Data Manager sarà coinvolto principalmente nell’Iniziativa nazionale sull’oncologia di precisione (NAIPO), che trasforma la cura del cancro in Svizzera integrando l’IA avanzata lungo il percorso del paziente. Unisce ospedali, aziende e startup per promuovere l’innovazione, ridurre i costi sanitari e posizionare la Svizzera come leader nella medicina personalizzata. La NAIPO è guidata dal Centro AI dell'EPFL e comprende 31 partner tra cui università, ospedali cantonali e privati, infrastrutture di ricerca nazionali come SDSC e CSCS, università, aziende private come aziende farmaceutiche o start-up. Questa missione principale sarà integrata da un ruolo aggiuntivo nel sostenere le iniziative di traduzione guidate dall’SDSC. Si prega di notare che verranno prese in considerazione solo le candidature che soddisfano i criteri dell'annuncio. Principali compiti e responsabilità Collaborerai con il Centro EPFL AI, l'SDSC e i suoi partner clinici, il team di supporto gestionale della NAIPO, il dipartimento/ufficio legale di ciascun partner, i coordinatori clinici e i membri della NAIPO. Nel contesto di NAIPO, dovrai:
• Coordinare una valutazione completa dell'impatto della protezione dei dati (DPIA) con partner di ricerca, ospedali e legali, valutando i rischi per la privacy e le strategie di mitigazione per ciascun sottoprogetto.
• Coordinare la stesura dei protocolli di studio clinico secondo la legge svizzera sulla ricerca umana e dei moduli di informazione e consenso dei pazienti standardizzati (PICF).
• Sviluppare un quadro modulare di conformità alla privacy dei dati.
• Sviluppare accordi standard sul trattamento e sul trasferimento dei dati (DPA, DTA).
• Definire linee guida per la validazione del modello di IA in linea con gli standard Swissmedic e le norme ISO per il software medico, garantendo che l'implementazione clinica degli strumenti di IA soddisfi le aspettative normative.
• Coordinarsi con i diversi dipartimenti/uffici legali di ciascuna istituzione.
• Definire, mantenere e supervisionare la gestione dei dati della NAIPO, in stretta collaborazione con i gestori dei dati di SDSC e i partner di implementazione.
• Sviluppare e implementare un piano di monitoraggio normativo per tenere traccia delle modifiche alle normative sulla protezione dei dati, sull'intelligenza artificiale e sulla ricerca clinica nel corso della durata del progetto, garantendo la conformità adattiva. Promozione dell'EPFL AI Center, gestione della nostra vasta rete di partner e costruzione del nostro ecosistema in Svizzera e oltre. Inoltre, nel contesto dell'intelligenza artificiale traslazionale SDSC per progetti di ricerca sanitaria,
• Sosterrai la scrittura di accordi di elaborazione, trasferimento e utilizzo dei dati (DPA, DTUA) per progetti sanitari e biomedici.
• Supporto alle organizzazioni – in particolare alle PMI svizzere – nel percorso verso SAMD: consigliarle su quali tipologie di progetti e prodotti richiedono esplicitamente di sottoporsi al processo e quali lo rendono altamente raccomandato; consigliarli sul processo e sulle tappe fondamentali legate ai diversi livelli SAMD. Profilo
• Più di cinque anni di esperienza professionale in un ambiente normativo clinico e nella scrittura di protocolli clinici
• Competenza dimostrata del panorama normativo svizzero e dei comitati etici (Legge svizzera sulla ricerca umana, norme sulla protezione dei dati…)
• Esperienza nella negoziazione con comitati etici
• Comprovata capacità di tradurre i requisiti normativi in ​​quadri operativi pratici per progetti complessi con più partner
• Capacità di integrazione in ambienti altamente dinamici
• Capacità di gestire più progetti contemporaneamente e rispettare le scadenze
• Excel

descriptionByLocale.de:
Mission Das EPFL Al Center konzentriert sich auf die Förderung von Forschung, Bildung und Innovation im Bereich Al an der EPFL und darüber hinaus. Es ist der Kern einer lebendigen EPFL-Gemeinschaft und eines dynamischen externen Ökosystems, das eine große Anzahl von Partnern und Interessenvertretern in der Al umfasst, darunter Wissenschaft, Industrie, Regierung und internationale Organisationen. Wir suchen einen Regulatory Data Manager für nationale Initiativen im Bereich KI für die Gesundheit. Die Rolle wird wichtige Forschungsinitiativen unterstützen, die vom EPFL AI Center und dem Swiss Data Science Center (SDSC) geleitet werden. Insbesondere wird der neue Regulatory Data Manager hauptsächlich an der National AI Initiative for Precision Oncology (NAIPO) beteiligt sein, die die Krebsbehandlung in der Schweiz durch die Integration fortschrittlicher KI in die gesamte Patientenreise transformiert. Es vereint Krankenhäuser, Unternehmen und Start-ups, um Innovationen voranzutreiben, Gesundheitskosten zu senken und die Schweiz als führendes Unternehmen in der personalisierten Medizin zu positionieren. NAIPO wird vom EPFL AI Center geleitet und umfasst 31 Partner wie Universitäten, kantonale und private Spitäler, nationale Forschungsinfrastrukturen wie SDSC und CSCS, Universitäten, private Unternehmen wie Pharmaunternehmen oder Start-ups. Diese Hauptaufgabe wird durch eine zusätzliche Rolle bei der Unterstützung von Übersetzungsinitiativen unter der Leitung des SDSC ergänzt. Bitte beachten Sie, dass nur Bewerbungen berücksichtigt werden, die den Kriterien der Ausschreibung entsprechen. Hauptaufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten Sie arbeiten mit dem EPFL AI Center, dem SDSC und seinen klinischen Partnern, dem NAIPO Management Support Team, der Rechtsabteilung/Büro jedes Partners, den klinischen Koordinatoren und den NAIPO-Mitgliedern zusammen. Im Rahmen von NAIPO werden Sie
• eine umfassende Datenschutz-Folgenabschätzung (DPIA) mit Forschungs-, Krankenhaus- und Rechtspartnern koordinieren und dabei Datenschutzrisiken und Minderungsstrategien für jedes Teilprojekt bewerten.
• Koordinieren Sie die Erstellung klinischer Studienprotokolle gemäß dem Schweizer Humanforschungsgesetz und standardisierten Patienteninformations- und Einwilligungsformularen (PICFs).
• Entwickeln Sie ein modulares Datenschutz-Compliance-Framework.
• Entwickeln Sie Standarddatenverarbeitungs- und -übertragungsvereinbarungen (DPAs, DTAs).
• Definieren Sie Richtlinien zur KI-Modellvalidierung, die an den Swissmedic-Standards und ISO-Normen für medizinische Software ausgerichtet sind, und stellen Sie sicher, dass der klinische Einsatz von KI-Tools den regulatorischen Erwartungen entspricht.
• Koordinierung mit den verschiedenen Rechtsabteilungen/Büros jeder Institution.
• Definieren, pflegen und überwachen Sie das Datenmanagement von NAIPO in enger Zusammenarbeit mit den Datenmanagern von SDSC und den Implementierungspartnern.
• Entwickeln und implementieren Sie einen regulatorischen Überwachungsplan, um Änderungen an Datenschutz-, KI- und klinischen Forschungsvorschriften während der Projektlaufzeit zu verfolgen und eine adaptive Compliance sicherzustellen. Förderung des EPFL AI Center, Verwaltung unseres umfangreichen Partnernetzwerks und Aufbau unseres Ökosystems in der Schweiz und darüber hinaus. Darüber hinaus werden Sie im Rahmen der SDSC-Translations-KI für Gesundheitsforschungsprojekte
• die Erstellung von Datenverarbeitungs-, Übertragungs- und Nutzungsvereinbarungen (DPAs, DTUAs) für Gesundheits- und biomedizinische Projekte unterstützen.
• Unterstützung von Organisationen – insbesondere Schweizer KMU – auf dem Weg zu SAMD: Beratung darüber, welche Arten von Projekten und Produkten den Prozess ausdrücklich erfordern und welche ihn dringend empfehlen; beraten sie über den Prozess und die Meilensteine, die mit den verschiedenen SAMD-Ebenen verbunden sind. Profil
• Mehr als fünf Jahre Berufserfahrung im klinischen Regulierungsumfeld und im Verfassen klinischer Protokolle
• Nachgewiesene Fachkenntnis der Schweizer Regulierungslandschaft und Ethikkommissionen (Schweizer Humanforschungsgesetz, Datenschutzbestimmungen…)
• Erfahrung in Verhandlungen mit Ethikkommissionen
• Nachgewiesene Fähigkeit, regulatorische Anforderungen in praktische betriebliche Rahmenbedingungen für komplexe Projekte mit mehreren Partnern umzusetzen
• Fähigkeit zur Integration in hochdynamische Umgebungen
• Fähigkeit, mehrere Projekte gleichzeitig zu verwalten und Fristen einzuhalten
• Excel
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Mission L'EPFL Al Center se concentre sur l'avancement de la recherche, de l'éducation et de l'innovation dans le domaine de l'IA à l'EPFL et au-delà. Il est au cœur d'une communauté EPFL dynamique et d'un écosystème externe dynamique qui comprend un grand nombre de partenaires et de parties prenantes de l'IA, notamment des universités, des entreprises, des gouvernements et des organisations internationales. Nous recherchons un gestionnaire de données réglementaires pour les initiatives nationales en matière d'IA pour la santé. Ce rôle soutiendra d'importantes initiatives de recherche menées par l'EPFL AI Center et le Swiss Data Science Center (SDSC). En particulier, le nouveau Regulatory Data Manager sera principalement impliqué dans la National AI Initiative for Precision Oncology (NAIPO), qui transforme les soins contre le cancer en Suisse en intégrant l'IA avancée tout au long du parcours du patient. Il rassemble des hôpitaux, des entreprises et des startups pour stimuler l'innovation, réduire les coûts des soins de santé et positionner la Suisse comme leader de la médecine personnalisée. Le NAIPO est dirigé par l'EPFL AI Center et comprend 31 partenaires tels que des universités, des hôpitaux cantonaux et privés, des infrastructures de recherche nationales comme le SDSC et le CSCS, des universités, des entreprises privées comme des sociétés pharmaceutiques ou des start-up. Cette mission principale sera complétée par un rôle supplémentaire de soutien aux initiatives translationnelles menées par la SDSC. Veuillez noter que seules les candidatures répondant aux critères de l'annonce seront prises en considération. Principales tâches et responsabilités Vous collaborerez avec l'EPFL AI Center, le SDSC et ses partenaires cliniques, l'équipe de support à la gestion de la NAIPO, le service/bureau juridique de chaque partenaire, les coordinateurs cliniques et les membres de la NAIPO. Dans le contexte de la NAIPO, vous :
• Coordonnerez une évaluation complète de l'impact sur la protection des données (DPIA) avec des partenaires de recherche, hospitaliers et juridiques, en évaluant les risques liés à la vie privée et les stratégies d'atténuation pour chaque sous-projet.
• Coordonner la rédaction de protocoles d'études cliniques conformément à la loi suisse sur la recherche humaine et aux formulaires standardisés d'information et de consentement des patients (PICF).
• Développer un cadre modulaire de conformité de la confidentialité des données.
• Développer des accords standards de traitement et de transfert de données (DPA, DTA).
• Définir des directives de validation du modèle d'IA alignées sur les standards Swissmedic et les normes ISO pour les logiciels médicaux, garantissant que le déploiement clinique des outils d'IA répond aux attentes réglementaires.
• Coordonner avec les différents départements/bureaux juridiques de chaque institution.
• Définir, maintenir et superviser la gestion des données de la NAIPO, en étroite collaboration avec les gestionnaires de données du SDSC et les partenaires de mise en œuvre.
• Élaborer et mettre en œuvre un plan de surveillance réglementaire pour suivre les modifications apportées aux réglementations en matière de protection des données, d'IA et de recherche clinique tout au long de la durée de vie du projet, garantissant ainsi une conformité adaptative. Promouvoir l'EPFL AI Center, gérer notre vaste réseau de partenaires et construire notre écosystème en Suisse et au-delà. De plus, dans le contexte de l'IA translationnelle SDSC pour les projets de recherche en santé, vous
• Soutenir la rédaction d'accords de traitement, de transfert et d'utilisation des données (DPA, DTUA) pour des projets de santé et biomédicaux.
• Accompagnement des organisations – notamment des PME suisses – dans leur démarche vers la SAMD : les conseiller sur les types de projets et de produits qui nécessitent explicitement de passer par la démarche, et ceux qui la rendent fortement recommandée ; les conseiller sur le processus et les étapes liées aux différents niveaux du SAMD. Profil
• Plus de cinq ans d'expérience professionnelle dans un environnement réglementaire clinique et dans la rédaction de protocoles cliniques
• Expertise démontrée du paysage réglementaire suisse et des comités d'éthique (loi suisse sur la recherche humaine, réglementation sur la protection des données…)
• Expérience de la négociation avec des comités d'éthique
• Capacité avérée à traduire les exigences réglementaires en cadres opérationnels pratiques pour des projets complexes multipartenaires
• Capacité à s'intégrer dans des environnements très dynamiques
• Capacités à gérer plusieurs projets à la fois et à respecter les délais
• Excel

jobs.description:
Mission

The Laboratory of Photonics and Quantum Measurements is seeking a Laboratory Manager to oversee and implement data management and regulatory compliance and support the laboratory’s experimental research. The role involves laboratory organisation, equipment maintenance, documentation management, user support and coordination of shared experimental infrastructure.

Main duties and responsibilities

• Laboratory compliance: help establish and maintain good laboratory practices, user routines, documentation standards, and internal procedures. Maintain the safety, organization and cleanliness of laboratories and storage spaces in compliance with laboratory rules and in coordination with group members. Implement a booking system for lab equipment usage by spin-offs. Organise new setups, lab spaces and renovations (Advanced Science Building). Oversee safety audits and lab safety training for internal and external users.

• Data management and team support: control of laboratory notebooks (TEAMS), management of internal IT simulation software for the laboratory (COMSOL, Lumerical, Ansys and Sonnet) and assist in monitoring and establishing proper documentation of scientific and technical results (via e.g. GIT, Lab/task management software). Initiate weekly laboratory organization meetings with sub-teams. Support the onboarding and training of new students, postdocs, and technical staff in laboratory routines.

• Cleanroom support (fabrication, packaging, and sample flow coordination): liaise with the R&D team and senior processing engineer to ensure the continuity of fabrication-related activities, including nanofabrication tasks, documentation of established processes and techniques, and equipment requests (platform tools), as well as installation and testing. Contribute to maintaining and improving routines for photonic chip packaging, testing, and experimental integration.

• Equipment : assist with purchase orders of large-scale equipment, including commissioning, installation, troubleshooting, maintenance, repairs and upgrades.

• Records management: maintain an internal database of stock/inventory of materials and equipment, as well as a central inventory system.

• Continuous monitoring and innovation management: maintain an orderly environment in the labs (ASANA) and take the lead in adopting the latest technology and software to efficiently document knowledge, samples and research management.

Profile

For this position, we are looking for solution-oriented candidates with the following profile:

• Master’s degree or PhD in EE, Physics or Computer Science

• Attention to detail and passion for organization and efficiency

• Management experience in a similar role

• Familiarity with software and computer programming (Python, GIT, etc.) strongly preferred

• Basic cleanroom experience preferable

• Excellent technical problem-solving skills

• Open-mindedness, communication skills and critical thinking

• Willingness to learn

• Working proficiency in English and French (written/spoken)

We offer

• Excellent international working environment with access to world-class facilities

• A young, dynamic, flexible and highly motivated research group

• EPFL is located in the French speaking part of Switzerland on the shores of Lake Geneva, with a university campus offering a rich cultural environment

Information

Contract Start Date : 01.08.2026

Activity Rate : 50 - 70%

Contract Type: CDD

Duration: 1 year, renewable

Reference: 2311

Contact

For complementary information, please contact Prof. Tobias Kippenberg per e-mail: tobias.kippenberg@epfl.ch

descriptionByLocale.it: Missione Il Laboratorio di Fotonici e Misure Quantiche sta cercando un Responsabile Laboratorio di supervisionare e implementare la gestione dei dati e la conformità normativa e sostenere la ricerca sperimentale del laboratorio. Il ruolo riguarda l'organizzazione di laboratorio, la manutenzione delle attrezzature, la gestione della documentazione, il supporto degli utenti e il coordinamento delle infrastrutture sperimentali condivise. • Conformità del laboratorio: contribuire a stabilire e mantenere buone pratiche di laboratorio, routine degli utenti, standard di documentazione e procedure interne. Mantenere la sicurezza, l'organizzazione e la pulizia dei laboratori e degli spazi di stoccaggio in conformità alle regole di laboratorio e in coordinamento con i membri del gruppo. Implementare un sistema di prenotazione per l'utilizzo di attrezzature da laboratorio tramite spin-off. Organizzare nuove configurazioni, spazi di laboratorio e ristrutturazioni (Advanced Science Building). Superare i controlli di sicurezza e la formazione di sicurezza di laboratorio per gli utenti interni ed esterni. • Gestione dei dati e supporto del team: controllo dei notebook di laboratorio (TEAMS), gestione del software di simulazione IT interno per il laboratorio (COMSOL, Lumerical, Ansys e Sonnet) e assistenza nel monitoraggio e nella creazione di una corretta documentazione dei risultati scientifici e tecnici (ad esempio GIT, Lab/task management software). Avviare riunioni settimanali di organizzazione di laboratorio con sub-team. Sostenere l'imbarco e la formazione di nuovi studenti, postdoc e personale tecnico nelle routine di laboratorio. • Supporto Cleanroom (fabricazione, confezionamento e coordinamento del flusso dei campioni): liaise con il team R&D e l'ingegnere di elaborazione senior per garantire la continuità delle attività connesse alla fabbricazione, tra cui compiti di nanofabbricazione, documentazione di processi e tecniche consolidate, e richieste di attrezzature (trumenti di piattaforma), nonché installazione e test. Contribuisci a mantenere e migliorare le routine per l'imballaggio di chip fotonico, il test e l'integrazione sperimentale. • Attrezzatura: assistere con ordini di acquisto di attrezzature su larga scala, tra cui messa in servizio, installazione, risoluzione dei problemi, manutenzione, riparazioni e aggiornamenti. • Gestione delle registrazioni: mantenere un database interno di magazzino/inventario di materiali e attrezzature, nonché un sistema di inventario centrale. • Gestione continua del monitoraggio e dell'innovazione: mantenere un ambiente ordinato nei laboratori (ASANA) e prendere il comando nell'adottare le ultime tecnologie e software per documentare in modo efficiente le conoscenze, i campioni e la gestione della ricerca. Profilo Per questa posizione, siamo alla ricerca di candidati orientati alla soluzione con il seguente profilo: • Laurea magistrale o dottorato in EE, Fisica o Informatica • Attenzione al dettaglio e alla passione per l'organizzazione e l'efficienza • Esperienza di gestione in un ruolo simile • Familiarità con software e programmazione del computer (Python, GIT, ecc.) fortemente preferito • Esperienza di pulizia di base preferibili • Capacità di risoluzione dei problemi tecnici eccellenti • • Eccellente ambiente di lavoro internazionale con accesso a strutture di livello mondiale • Un gruppo di ricerca giovane, dinamico, flessibile e altamente motivato • EPFL si trova nella parte francofona della Svizzera sulle rive del lago di Ginevra, con un campus universitario che offre un ricco ambiente culturale Information Contract Data di inizio: 01.08.2026 Tasso di attività: 50 - 70% Tipo di contratto: CDD Durata: 1 anno, rinnovabile Riferimento: 2311 Contatto Per informazioni complementari, rivolgersi al Prof. Tobias Kippenberg per e-mail: tobias.kippenberg@epfl.ch

• Data management and team support: control of laboratory notebooks (TEAMS), management of internal IT simulation software for the laboratory (COMSOL, Lumerical, Ansys and Sonnet) and assist in monitoring and establishing proper documentation of scientific and technical results (via e.g. GIT, Lab/task management software). Initiate weekly laboratory organization meetings with sub-teams. Support the onboarding and training of new students, postdocs, and technical staff in laboratory routines.

• Cleanroom support (fabrication, packaging, and sample flow coordination): liaise with the R&D team and senior processing engineer to ensure the continuity of fabrication-related activities, including nanofabrication tasks, documentation of established processes and techniques, and equipment requests (platform tools), as well as installation and testing. Contribute to maintaining and improving routines for photonic chip packaging, testing, and experimental integration.

• Equipment : assist with purchase orders of large-scale equipment, including commissioning, installation, troubleshooting, maintenance, repairs and upgrades.

• Records management: maintain an internal database of stock/inventory of materials and equipment, as well as a central inventory system.

• Continuous monitoring and innovation management: maintain an orderly environment in the labs (ASANA) and take the lead in adopting the latest technology and software to efficiently document knowledge, samples and research management.

Profile

For this position, we are looking for solution-oriented candidates with the following profile:

• Master’s degree or PhD in EE, Physics or Computer Science

• Attention to detail and passion for organization and efficiency

• Management experience in a similar role

• Familiarity with software and computer programming (Python, GIT, etc.) strongly preferred

• Basic cleanroom experience preferable

• Excellent technical problem-solving skills

• Open-mindedness, communication skills and critical thinking

• Willingness to learn

• Working proficiency in English and French (written/spoken)

We offer

• Excellent international working environment with access to world-class facilities

• A young, dynamic, flexible and highly motivated research group

• EPFL is located in the French speaking part of Switzerland on the shores of Lake Geneva, with a university campus offering a rich cultural environment

Information

Contract Start Date : 01.08.2026

Activity Rate : 50 - 70%

Contract Type: CDD

Duration: 1 year, renewable

Reference: 2311

Contact

For complementary information, please contact Prof. Tobias Kippenberg per e-mail: tobias.kippenberg@epfl.ch
